attributes.name: sprint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active sprint to which this backlog item is assigned. Used for sprint velocity calculation and burn-down tracking. Null if the item is in the product backlog and not yet sprint-committed.

attributes.name: title_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_season. Business justification: In GaaS studios, backlog items are scoped to a season for seasonal content delivery planning. Season-level backlog burndown reports, seasonal content completion tracking, and sprint planning for seaso

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Structured definition-of-done criteria that must be satisfied for this backlog item to be accepted by the product owner or QA team. Sourced from Jira custom field. Drives UAT sign-off and release gate decisions.
attributes.references: Scrum Guide — Definition of Done; UAT Sign-Off Process; IGDA Agile Game Development Practices

attributes.name: affected_version
attributes.description: The game build version in which a defect or regression was first observed. Applicable primarily to Bug issue types. Supports root-cause analysis and regression tracking across release branches.
attributes.references: Jira Affects Version Field; QA Regression Testing Standards

attributes.name: backlog_item_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the backlog item including acceptance criteria, technical notes, and business context. Sourced from the Jira description field; may include references to design documents or Perforce changelists.

attributes.name: blocker_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the impediment or dependency causing this backlog item to be blocked. Populated when is_blocked is True. Used by Scrum Masters and producers to track and resolve impediments.
attributes.references: Jira Impediment Comment; Scrum Guide — Impediment Log

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog item is associated with a regulatory or platform compliance requirement (e.g., GDPR data handling, COPPA age-gating, ESRB rating descriptor implementation, PCI DSS payment flow, TRC/TCR certification). Compliance-flagged items receive elevated priority and mandatory QA sign-off.
attributes.references: GDPR Supervisory Authorities; COPPA (FTC); ESRB; PEGI; PCI SSC; TRC/TCR Platform Certification

attributes.name: component
attributes.description: The game system or technical component this backlog item relates to (e.g., 'Rendering', 'Networking', 'UI/UX', 'Audio', 'Physics', 'Monetization', 'FTUE'). Maps to Jira Components field. Enables component-level defect density and velocity analysis.
attributes.references: Jira Components Field; Unity/Unreal Engine Asset Pipeline Taxonomy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this backlog item was first created in Jira. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for aging analysis, backlog health metrics, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Jira Issue Created Field; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The target completion date for this backlog item as set by the producer or product owner. Used for milestone tracking, release planning, and escalation triggers when items approach or exceed their due date.
attributes.references: Jira Due Date Field; Project Milestone Management

attributes.name: environment
attributes.description: The deployment environment context for this backlog item. Particularly relevant for Bug and Tech Debt items to indicate where the issue was observed or where the fix must be validated before promotion to production/live.
attributes.references: CI/CD Pipeline Standards; Jira Environment Field

attributes.name: epic_key
attributes.description: Reference to the parent epic that groups this backlog item under a larger feature or initiative. Enables roll-up reporting of story points and progress at the epic level.

attributes.name: fix_version
attributes.description: The game build version or release milestone in which this backlog item is targeted to be delivered (e.g., '1.4.0', 'Season 3 Patch'). Used for release planning, version-level burn-down, and first-party certification submission tracking.
attributes.references: Jira Fix Version Field; Steamworks/Console SDK Release Management

attributes.name: gaas_live_ops_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Game as a Service (GaaS) Live Operations Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog item is part of the GaaS live operations cadence (e.g., seasonal content update, live event, hotfix, balance patch). GaaS-flagged items follow an expedited review and deployment pipeline distinct from standard release cycles.
attributes.references: GaaS Live Operations Process; CI/CD Hotfix Pipeline

attributes.name: is_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog item is currently blocked by a dependency, external factor, or unresolved impediment. Blocked items are escalated in daily stand-ups and producer dashboards to prevent sprint velocity degradation.
attributes.references: Jira Impediment Flag; Scrum Guide — Impediment Management

attributes.name: is_regression
attributes.description: Indicates whether this Bug backlog item represents a regression — a defect that was previously fixed and has reappeared. Regression tracking is critical for release quality metrics and CI/CD gate enforcement.
attributes.references: QA Regression Testing Standards; CI/CD Release Gate Process

attributes.name: issue_key
attributes.description: The externally-known Jira issue key (e.g., GAME-1234) that uniquely identifies this backlog item within the project. Used by developers, producers, and QA to reference work items across tools and communications. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Jira Issue Object — Issue Key Field

attributes.name: issue_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work item within the Agile/Scrum taxonomy. Drives workflow routing, estimation norms, and reporting segmentation. In Kanban or waterfall studios this maps to the equivalent work unit type (ticket, task, work order). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Epic|Story|Task|Sub-task|Bug|Spike|Tech Debt|Change Request|Improvement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Jira Issue Type Configuration; IGDA Agile Game Development Practices

attributes.name: jira_issue_key
attributes.description: The internal numeric identifier assigned by Jira to this issue (distinct from the human-readable issue_key). Used for API-level integration, webhook event correlation, and bidirectional sync between Jira and the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Jira REST API — Issue Object ID Field

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Comma-separated free-text labels applied to the backlog item for cross-cutting classification (e.g., 'GaaS', 'MTX', 'GDPR', 'TRC', 'performance', 'accessibility'). Sourced from Jira Labels field. Supports ad-hoc filtering and compliance tagging.
attributes.references: Jira Labels Field; GDPR Supervisory Authorities; ESRB Compliance

attributes.name: original_estimate_hours
attributes.description: Initial time estimate in hours logged in Jira at the time of issue creation or sprint planning. Used alongside story points for studios that track both relative and absolute effort estimates.

attributes.name: perforce_changelist
attributes.description: The Perforce Helix Core changelist number(s) linked to this backlog item for code traceability. Enables bidirectional traceability between Jira work items and version-controlled source code changes. May contain multiple changelist references as a comma-separated string.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core — Changelist Object; CI/CD Traceability Standards

attributes.name: platform_target
attributes.description: The deployment platform(s) this backlog item is scoped to. Drives platform-specific QA routing, TRC/TCR compliance checks, and first-party certification workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|Console|Mobile|Cross-Platform|VR/AR|Cloud — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; TRC/TCR Platform Certification Requirements

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business and technical priority of the backlog item as set by the product owner or producer. Blocker and Critical items trigger escalation workflows and may gate sprint completion or release sign-off.
attributes.references: Jira Priority Field; QA Severity Classification

attributes.name: qa_sign_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the QA team formally signed off on this backlog item as meeting acceptance criteria. Required for release gate passage and first-party certification submission. Null if QA sign-off has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: QA Sign-Off Process; TRC/TCR Certification Requirements; UAT Sign-Off Standards

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.description: The outcome recorded when a backlog item is closed or resolved. Distinguishes genuinely completed work from items closed for other reasons (duplicate, out of scope, cannot reproduce). Critical for QA defect metrics and release quality reporting.
attributes.references: Jira Resolution Field; QA Defect Management Standards

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this backlog item transitioned to a resolved or done state. Maps to BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used to calculate cycle time, lead time, and sprint velocity metrics.
attributes.references: Jira Issue Resolved Field; Scrum Velocity Metrics

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this backlog item record was ingested into the lakehouse. Primarily Jira for standard Agile studios; may be Manual for waterfall studios or Migration for legacy project management system imports.
attributes.references: Data Lineage Standards; ETL Pipeline Metadata; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: sprint_committed_date
attributes.description: The date on which this backlog item was committed to a sprint during sprint planning. Distinguishes items that were planned from the start of the sprint versus those added mid-sprint (scope creep indicator).
attributes.references: Jira Sprint Planning; Scrum Guide — Sprint Planning Event

attributes.name: started_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when work on this backlog item was first started (transitioned to In Progress). Used to calculate cycle time (started to resolved) distinct from lead time (created to resolved). Key metric for flow efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Jira Status Transition History; Agile Flow Metrics

attributes.name: story_points
attributes.description: Relative effort estimate assigned to this backlog item using the Fibonacci or T-shirt sizing scale. Core input for sprint velocity calculation and producer capacity planning. Null for items not yet estimated (e.g., items in the icebox).
attributes.references: Scrum Guide — Story Point Estimation; IGDA Agile Game Development Practices

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title of the backlog item as entered in Jira (e.g., 'Implement loot box drop-rate display per ESRB guidelines'). The primary label used in sprint boards, backlogs, and producer dashboards.

attributes.name: time_spent_hours
attributes.description: Actual hours logged against this backlog item via Jira work logs. Compared against original_estimate_hours to measure estimation accuracy and identify scope creep. Feeds into SAP S/4HANA project cost accounting.
attributes.references: Jira Time Tracking — Time Spent; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS)

attributes.name: uat_sign_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product owner or designated stakeholder completed UAT and formally accepted this backlog item. Distinct from QA sign-off; represents business acceptance rather than technical verification.
attributes.references: UAT Sign-Off Process; Jira Approval Workflow

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this backlog item was last modified in Jira. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Jira Issue Updated Field; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current state of the backlog item in its Jira workflow lifecycle. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Drives sprint burn-down charts, release readiness gates, and CI/CD pipeline triggers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Backlog|To Do|In Progress|In Review|QA|Done|Closed|Cancelled|Blocked — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Jira Workflow Status; CI/CD Release Gate Process

products.name: milestone
products.description: Production milestone records for a development project, representing major delivery gates such as concept approval, pre-production sign-off, vertical slice, first playable, alpha, beta, content complete, gold master (GM), and first-party submission. Captures milestone name, milestone type, planned date, actual date, completion status, sign-off owner, associated deliverables checklist, and blocker count. Sourced from Jira release planning or studio production management tools (Shotgrid/Productive). Critical for release planning, publisher reporting, and greenlight decision-making.

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the production milestone record in the studio domain. Primary key for the milestone data product.

attributes.name: age_rating_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.age_rating_cert. Business justification: Milestones gate on age rating cert approval (e.g., cert submission/approval dates). Direct link enables tracking which cert blocked/cleared which milestone, critical for ship schedule management.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game development project this milestone belongs to. Links the milestone to its parent production project.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal or external development studio responsible for delivering this milestone.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title associated with this production milestone, enabling cross-domain reporting between studio and game title domains.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Compliance milestone gates: milestones such as gold master, cert submission, and publisher sign-off are gated by specific regulatory obligations (TRC/TCR compliance, GDPR sign-off, COPPA certification

attributes.name: repo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.repo. Business justification: A production milestone is cut at a specific Perforce depot/repository (milestone has a perforce_changelist attribute indicating the exact changelist at which the milestone was captured). Direct FK to

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the milestone was achieved and accepted. Null if the milestone has not yet been completed. Used to calculate schedule variance against planned and revised dates.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: blocker_count
attributes.description: The number of open blocking issues (P0/P1 bugs or critical dependencies) preventing milestone completion at the time of last update. Sourced from Jira bug tracking. A non-zero value typically prevents sign-off and triggers escalation.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking; IGDA Production Standards

attributes.name: build_version
attributes.description: The game build version number or label associated with the milestone submission (e.g., '1.0.0.4521'). Sourced from the CI/CD pipeline or Perforce Helix Core version control. Critical for first-party submission and QA traceability.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control; CI/CD Release Gates

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system, sourced from Jira or the studio production management tool. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: critical_bug_count
attributes.description: The number of critical severity (P1) defects open against this milestone at the time of last update, as tracked in Jira. Distinct from blocker_count which captures only hard-blocking issues. Used for QA readiness assessment.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking; Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: deliverables_checklist_url
attributes.description: URL or deep-link reference to the associated deliverables checklist document for this milestone (e.g., a Confluence page, Shotgrid task list, or Jira epic). Captures the list of required artifacts and acceptance criteria for milestone completion.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: deliverables_completed
attributes.description: The number of deliverable items in the milestone checklist that have been completed and accepted at the time of last update. Used with deliverables_total for progress tracking.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: deliverables_total
attributes.description: The total number of discrete deliverable items defined in the milestone checklist. Used alongside deliverables_completed to calculate completion percentage for progress reporting.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: epic_key
attributes.description: The Jira epic identifier grouping the feature work associated with this milestone. Enables traceability from milestone to epic-level scope in the Jira backlog.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking

attributes.name: is_greenlight_gate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this milestone serves as a greenlight decision point requiring executive or publisher approval to proceed to the next production phase. Greenlight gates are critical for go/no-go decisions.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; Publisher Contract Management

attributes.name: is_publisher_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this milestone is a contractual publisher-facing delivery gate (True) or an internal studio milestone (False). Publisher-facing milestones trigger formal reporting and may have contractual payment implications.
attributes.references: Publisher Contract Management; IGDA Production Standards

attributes.name: is_signed_off
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the milestone has received formal sign-off approval. True when sign-off is complete; False when pending. Enables quick filtering for release gate dashboards.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; Jira Release Planning

attributes.name: jira_release_key
attributes.description: The externally-known Jira release or version identifier corresponding to this milestone (e.g., the Jira Fix Version ID). Serves as the business identifier linking this record to the source system of record.

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the milestone scope, acceptance criteria, and key deliverables as defined in the production plan. Provides context for publisher reporting and greenlight decision-making.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; IGDA Production Standards

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the production milestone as defined in the studio production plan or Jira release (e.g., 'Alpha Build', 'Gold Master', 'First Playable'). Serves as the primary identity label for the milestone.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone within the production workflow. Tracks progression from not started through in-progress, at-risk, missed, completed, and final sign-off. Used for release planning dashboards and publisher reporting.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; IGDA Production Standards

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the milestone representing its role in the game development lifecycle delivery gate. Standard types include concept approval, pre-production sign-off, vertical slice, first playable, alpha, beta, content complete, gold master (GM), and first-party submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept_approval|pre_production|vertical_slice|first_playable|alpha|beta|content_complete|gold_master|first_party_submission — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; First-Party Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC)

attributes.name: open_issue_count
attributes.description: Total number of open Jira issues (across all severities) associated with this milestone at the time of last update. Provides a broad health indicator for milestone readiness.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The contractual payment amount due from the publisher upon successful sign-off of this milestone, if applicable. Sourced from the publishing agreement. Null for internal milestones with no associated payment trigger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Publisher Contract Management

attributes.name: perforce_changelist
attributes.description: The Perforce Helix Core changelist number representing the code and asset snapshot submitted for this milestone. Provides version control traceability for the milestone build.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control and Digital Asset Management

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The high-level production phase to which this milestone belongs. Segments milestones into pre-production, production, post-production, and live operations (GaaS) phases for portfolio-level reporting.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; GaaS Live Operations Framework

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled calendar date by which this milestone was planned to be achieved, as defined in the production schedule. Used for schedule variance analysis and publisher reporting.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Shotgrid/Productive Production Management

attributes.name: platform_target
attributes.description: The target gaming platform(s) for which this milestone applies (e.g., PS5, Xbox Series X, PC, iOS, Android, Nintendo Switch). Relevant for first-party submission milestones where platform-specific Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC) compliance is required.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; First-Party TRC/TCR Requirements

attributes.name: qa_sign_off_status
attributes.description: The Quality Assurance (QA) team's sign-off status for this milestone, indicating whether the build has passed QA acceptance criteria. Distinct from the overall milestone sign-off which may involve additional stakeholders.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking; IGDA QA Standards

attributes.name: revised_date
attributes.description: The most recently revised target date for milestone completion, reflecting any approved schedule changes or re-planning events. Distinct from the original planned date to support schedule slip tracking.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Publisher Contract Management

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed risk level for on-time delivery of this milestone, as evaluated by the production team. Used for escalation management and executive reporting.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; Internal Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: risk_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the primary risk factors or blockers threatening on-time milestone delivery. Populated by the production manager or project lead during milestone reviews.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; Jira Project Management

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which the actual completion date deviated from the planned date. Positive values indicate lateness; negative values indicate early delivery. Sourced from production management tooling and used for publisher reporting and greenlight decisions.
attributes.references: IGDA Production Standards; Publisher Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the milestone received formal sign-off approval from the designated owner. Null if sign-off has not yet occurred. Critical for publisher reporting and contractual compliance.
attributes.references: Publisher Contract Management; IGDA Production Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this milestone record was sourced (e.g., Jira, Shotgrid, Productive, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and ETL audit requirements in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: trc_compliance_status
attributes.description: The compliance status of this milestone against the first-party platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC) or Technical Certification Requirements (TCR). Applicable primarily to first-party submission milestones for console platforms.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; First-Party TRC/TCR Requirements; PEGI; ESRB

attributes.name: uat_status
attributes.description: The User Acceptance Testing (UAT) status for this milestone, reflecting whether the build has been validated by the publisher or internal stakeholders against acceptance criteria. UAT sign-off is typically required before milestone payment release.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking; Publisher Contract Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this milestone record was most recently modified, sourced from Jira or the studio production management tool. Used for incremental data loading and change tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001

products.name: build

Captures build number, build version string, target platform, build type (debug, development, shipping), branch name, changelist number, build status (success, failed, in-progress), build duration, artifact storage path, and triggered-by user. SSOT for build provenance and release gate tracking.

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each game build record generated by the CI/CD pipeline. Primary key for the build data product.

attributes.name: age_rating_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.age_rating_cert. Business justification: Builds submitted for platform certification must reference the age rating cert. Build.certification_status and content_rating denormalize cert data; direct link enables cert-gated build promotion work

attributes.name: asset_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset_bundle. Business justification: Builds package specific asset bundles into distributable artifacts. Build composition tracking, platform certification documentation, and rollback procedures require direct linkage to bundled content.

attributes.name: content_release_id

attributes.name: game_studio_id

attributes.name: game_title_id

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project milestone or sprint this build is associated with in the project management system (Jira). Links build provenance to the production schedule and release gate framework.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management; Internal Release Planning Standards

attributes.name: platform_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.platform_sku. Business justification: Build-to-SKU targeting: builds are compiled for a specific platform SKU (edition + platform combination). Certification and distribution pipelines require knowing which platform_sku a build targets. b

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Certification pipeline compliance: builds submitted for platform certification (Sony TRC, Microsoft TCR, Nintendo LOT) must satisfy specific regulatory obligations. Compliance and cert teams need to t

attributes.name: repo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.repo. Business justification: Builds are generated from code in a specific Perforce repository. The build table does not have a repo_id FK. Adding repo_id FK provides proper referential integrity. No columns to remove - branch_nam

attributes.name: sdk_integration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.sdk_integration. Business justification: Build SDK compliance: builds are compiled against a specific platform SDK version. Platform certification requires SDK version validation per build. build.sdk_version is a denormalized string replaced

attributes.name: server_fleet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.server_fleet. Business justification: Builds are deployed to server fleets for live operations. Core deployment tracking relationship required for fleet version management, rollback procedures, and capacity planning in multiplayer gaming

attributes.name: sprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.sprint. Business justification: Builds are triggered by CI/CD pipelines during development sprints. The build table has pipeline_job_name and pipeline_run_reference attributes, and sprint has build_number (STRING) as a denormalized

attributes.name: agent
attributes.description: Identifier of the build farm agent or machine that executed this build (e.g., 'build-agent-ps5-03'). Used for build farm health monitoring, agent utilization analysis, and diagnosing machine-specific build failures.
attributes.references: Internal CI/CD Pipeline Standards; Internal Infrastructure Management

attributes.name: artifact_size_mb
attributes.description: Total size of the build artifact package in megabytes. Used to monitor build bloat, enforce platform submission size limits (e.g., console disc capacity, mobile store limits), and track storage consumption trends.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Console SDK TRC/TCR

attributes.name: artifact_storage_path
attributes.description: Fully qualified path or URI to the build artifact package in the artifact repository or cloud storage (e.g., 's3://builds-bucket/game-title/2.4.1/ps5/shipping/'). Used by QA, release engineering, and platform submission workflows to locate the build package.
attributes.references: Internal Artifact Management Standards; Perforce Helix Core

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the Perforce Helix Core stream or branch from which this build was compiled (e.g., 'main', 'release/2.4', 'feature/new-map'). Critical for build provenance, hotfix tracking, and release gate validation.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control; Internal CI/CD Pipeline Standards

attributes.name: build_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing integer build number assigned by the CI/CD system (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity, or Unreal Build Tool). Used as the externally-known sequential identifier for this build within the pipeline.
attributes.references: Unity Build System; Unreal Engine Build Tool; Perforce Helix Core

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the build as reported by the CI/CD pipeline. 'success' indicates all compilation, linking, and packaging steps completed without error; 'failed' indicates a pipeline error; 'in_progress' indicates an active run; 'cancelled' indicates a user-aborted run; 'queued' indicates the build is pending execution.
attributes.references: Internal CI/CD Pipeline Standards; Jira Release Planning

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the build configuration controlling compiler optimizations, logging verbosity, and feature flags. 'debug' includes full symbols and assertions; 'development' enables profiling and console commands; 'shipping' is the production-optimized release candidate; 'test' is used for automated QA pipelines.
attributes.references: Unreal Engine Build Configuration Documentation; Unity Build Settings; TRC/TCR Platform Certification Requirements

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the build pipeline run reached a terminal state (success, failed, or cancelled). Used for build duration calculation, SLA compliance, and release gate scheduling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this build record was first inserted into the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: dlc_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific DLC or content pack this build packages, if applicable. Null for base game builds. Enables tracking of DLC build pipelines separately from the base game build pipeline.
attributes.references: Internal Content Release Management; Steamworks SDK; Console SDK TRC/TCR

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from build trigger to pipeline completion (success or failure). Key operational metric for CI/CD performance monitoring, build farm capacity planning, and developer productivity analysis.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: The game engine used to compile this build. Determines the toolchain, build configuration options, and platform support matrix applicable to this build.

attributes.name: deployment_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or rollout scope for this cycle deployment (e.g., 'GLOBAL', 'NA', 'EU', 'APAC', or specific country codes for soft-launch or staged rollouts). Supports regional compliance and staggered deployment strategies.
attributes.references: GDPR Supervisory Authorities — Regional Data Deployment; Platform Distribution Standard

attributes.name: esrb_content_descriptor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) Content Descriptor
attributes.description: ESRB content descriptor applicable to new content introduced in this cycle (e.g., 'Violence', 'In-Game Purchases', 'Users Interact'). Required for compliance with ESRB rating maintenance obligations when new content changes the rating profile of the game.
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) — Content Descriptor and Rating Maintenance Requirements

attributes.name: estimated_dev_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated development effort in person-hours allocated to produce this live ops cycle. Used for resource planning, sprint capacity management, and post-cycle retrospective analysis of estimation accuracy.
attributes.references: Jira Sprint and Capacity Planning; Studio Resource Allocation Standard

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processing_note
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processing Note
attributes.description: Free-text note documenting any new or changed player data processing activities introduced by this cycle (e.g., new telemetry events, new player data collection). Required for GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities compliance review.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 — Records of Processing Activities; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: has_battle_pass
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle includes a battle pass product offering. Distinct from the general MTX tie-in flag as battle passes have specific revenue recognition, player engagement, and retention analytics implications.
attributes.references: In-Game Monetization and Virtual Economy Management Standard

attributes.name: has_mtx_tie_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live ops cycle includes a direct microtransaction (MTX) monetization component such as a battle pass, limited-time store bundle, or premium currency event. True = monetization tie-in present; False = no direct MTX component.
attributes.references: In-Game Monetization and Virtual Economy Management Standard; FTC Advertising and Disclosure Guidelines

attributes.name: is_limited_time
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle is a time-bounded limited-time event (LTE) with a hard end date after which content is no longer accessible. Drives urgency-based player communication and FOMO-driven engagement strategies.
attributes.references: GaaS Live Operations Event Management Standard

attributes.name: is_soft_launch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle is deployed as a soft launch (limited regional or audience rollout) before a full global hard launch. Soft launches are used for live testing, performance validation, and player feedback collection prior to global deployment.
attributes.references: GaaS Soft Launch and Hard Launch Deployment Standard

attributes.name: jira_release_key
attributes.description: The Jira release/version identifier associated with this live ops cycle in the project management system (e.g., Jira Fix Version ID). Enables traceability from the live ops cycle back to the Jira backlog, epics, and sprint planning artifacts.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning — Fix Version / Release Object

attributes.name: open_bug_count_at_release
attributes.description: Number of open (unresolved) bugs in Jira at the time this cycle was released to production. Captures the known-issues baseline at deployment, used for post-release quality tracking and player support readiness.
attributes.references: Jira Bug Tracking — Open Defect Count at Release; Quality Assurance Standard

attributes.name: patch_notes_url
attributes.description: URL to the published patch notes or release notes document for this cycle. Used by community management, player support (Zendesk), and analytics teams to correlate player behavior changes with specific content updates.
attributes.references: Community Management Standard; Zendesk Knowledge Base Integration

attributes.name: pegi_content_descriptor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pan European Game Information (PEGI) Content Descriptor
attributes.description: PEGI content descriptor applicable to new content introduced in this cycle for European markets. Required for compliance with PEGI rating maintenance obligations when live content updates affect the game's rating classification.
attributes.references: PEGI (Pan European Game Information) — Content Descriptor and Rating Maintenance; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: perforce_label
attributes.description: The Perforce Helix Core label or changelist snapshot associated with the build deployed for this cycle. Provides version control traceability for the exact codebase and asset state shipped.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core — Label and Changelist Management

attributes.name: planned_release_date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled calendar date for deploying this live ops cycle to production. Used for production planning, player communication scheduling, and release gate tracking. Compared against actual_release_date to measure release predictability.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning — Target Release Date Field

attributes.name: player_comms_plan_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the player communication plan document for this cycle (e.g., patch notes document ID, community blog post URL, CRM campaign reference). Links production planning to community management and marketing execution.
attributes.references: Community Management and Player Support Standard; Salesforce CRM Campaign Reference

attributes.name: qa_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date the QA team formally signed off on the build for this live ops cycle, confirming it meets quality thresholds for release. Prerequisite for CI/CD release gate approval and platform certification submission.
attributes.references: Quality Assurance and Playtesting Standard; Jira Release Gate Workflow

attributes.name: release_gate_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CI/CD release gate for this cycle. 'pending' = gate checks not yet complete; 'passed' = all gates cleared for deployment; 'failed' = one or more gates blocked; 'waived' = gate bypassed with documented approval.
attributes.references: CI/CD Release Gate Standard; Quality Assurance and Playtesting Standard

attributes.name: rollback_version
attributes.description: The build version to which the game would be rolled back if this cycle deployment fails or causes critical issues. Defined as part of the deployment risk management plan for each live ops cycle.
attributes.references: GaaS Live Operations Incident Response and Rollback Standard

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: Sequential season number for cycles of type 'season' or 'battle_pass_rotation'. Null for non-seasonal cycle types. Used for player-facing season tracking, analytics cohort segmentation, and historical season comparison.
attributes.references: GaaS Live Operations Season Numbering Convention

attributes.name: sprint_count
attributes.description: Number of Jira sprints consumed to develop and deliver this live ops cycle. Used for production cadence analysis and GaaS live operations velocity benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_platforms
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms for which this cycle is deployed (e.g., 'PC,PS5,XSX,iOS,Android'). A cycle may deploy to all platforms simultaneously or in a staggered rollout. Used for platform certification tracking and deployment coordination.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs — Platform Deployment Standard; TRC/TCR Compliance

attributes.name: uat_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date the UAT sign-off was completed for this live ops cycle, confirming that internal stakeholders and/or external partners have accepted the content and functionality. Required release gate before deployment.
attributes.references: UAT (User Acceptance Testing) Sign-Off Standard; Jira Release Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this live ops cycle record (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; SOC 2 Audit Trail Requirements

domains.name: monetization
domains.description: Owns all in-game and platform revenue mechanisms including IAP, MTX, virtual currency economies, F2P conversion funnels, battle pass and subscription entitlements, loot box/gacha transaction records, DLC sales, and season passes. Tracks ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, LTV, whale segmentation, conversion rates, and P2W mechanics. The authoritative SSOT for HOW the business captures revenue from players.

products.name: subscription_plan
products.description: Master definition of recurring subscription products offered to players (e.g., monthly premium membership, game pass, cloud gaming subscription). Captures plan name, billing cycle (monthly/annual), price, trial period, entitlement grants (game access, currency stipend, exclusive content), auto-renew policy, platform availability, and lifecycle status. The SSOT for subscription product definitions.

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum age required to purchase subscription, enforced per COPPA, GDPR, and regional regulations. Zero indicates no age restriction.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription automatically renews at the end of each billing cycle. False requires manual renewal by player.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Recurring billing frequency for the subscription plan. Defines how often the player is charged.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_length
attributes.description: Number of billing periods in the subscription cycle (e.g., 1 for monthly, 12 for annual). Used for prorated calculations and renewal scheduling.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when subscription benefits terminate after cancellation and whether refunds are issued. Critical for churn rate analysis and player retention.

attributes.name: cloud_gaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription includes cloud gaming streaming capability, allowing gameplay without local hardware requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the subscription price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount on in-game purchases (MTX, DLC, IAP) granted to active subscribers. Used to calculate subscriber ROI and conversion incentives.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the subscription plan configuration is superseded by a new version. Null for current active version.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the subscription plan configuration becomes effective. Used for price changes, benefit updates, and historical tracking.

attributes.name: exclusive_content_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscribers receive access to exclusive game content, DLC, or early releases not available to non-subscribers.

attributes.name: game_library_access
attributes.description: Level of access to game catalog or library granted by subscription. Defines which game titles subscribers can play without additional purchase.

attributes.name: geographic_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where subscription is available for purchase. Used for regional pricing and compliance with local regulations (GDPR, COPPA).

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after failed payment before subscription is suspended. Allows players to update payment method without losing access.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription plan was first made available for purchase. Used for product lifecycle analysis and cohort segmentation.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_devices
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices that can simultaneously use the subscription. Used for family plans and multi-device access control.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the subscription plan record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: multiplayer_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription is required for online multiplayer gameplay (PvP, MMO, co-op). Common requirement for console platform subscriptions.

attributes.name: parental_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental consent is required for minors to subscribe, per COPPA and regional child protection regulations.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the subscription plan (e.g., PREMIUM_MONTHLY, GAMEPASS_ANNUAL). Used in platform APIs, billing systems, and player-facing interfaces.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription plan by product category. Determines entitlement structure and billing behavior.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms where subscription can be purchased and used (e.g., PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Mobile, Nintendo Switch). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PlayStation|Xbox|Mobile|Nintendo_Switch|Steam|Epic_Games_Store|iOS|Android — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_amount
attributes.description: Base recurring price charged per billing cycle before taxes, discounts, or promotional adjustments. Used for ARPU and ARPPU calculations.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Grouping of related subscription plans for reporting and analytics (e.g., Premium Tier, Game Pass Family, VIP Club). Used for portfolio analysis and cross-sell strategies.

attributes.name: refund_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription purchases are eligible for refund per platform policies and consumer protection regulations.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method for recognizing subscription revenue per GAAP/IFRS standards. Determines when revenue is recorded in financial statements.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Platform-specific SKU identifier used in app stores, console marketplaces, and distribution platforms for inventory and sales tracking.

attributes.name: subscription_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription plan. Active plans are available for new subscriptions; deprecated plans are closed to new subscribers but honor existing subscriptions.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription plan will be discontinued and no longer available for new or renewing subscriptions. Null for plans with no planned sunset.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification code for the subscription plan used to determine applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: trial_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the free trial period before first billing. Zero indicates no trial. Critical for F2P conversion funnel analysis and D1/D7/D30 retention tracking.

attributes.name: trial_price_amount
attributes.description: Discounted price charged during trial period. Typically zero for free trials or reduced for promotional trials.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_grant
attributes.description: Amount of in-game virtual currency (coins, gems, credits) granted to subscribers each billing cycle. Zero indicates no currency stipend. Key component of subscription LTV calculation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the subscription plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: player_subscription
products.description: Transactional record of a player's active or historical subscription to a subscription plan. Tracks player reference, plan reference, subscription start/end dates, current billing period, renewal status, cancellation reason, payment method token, platform storefront, trial used flag, and churn timestamp. The SSOT for individual player subscription lifecycle — feeds churn rate and LTV calculations.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription will automatically renew at the end of the current billing period. True means the subscription will renew unless cancelled. False means the subscription will expire at period end.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_count
attributes.description: The number of billing cycles that have been completed for this subscription. Used for retention cohort analysis and subscription age segmentation.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the subscription is billed. Determines billing cycle length, revenue recognition schedule, and churn calculation windows.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when the player cancelled the subscription. Null if the subscription has not been cancelled. Used for churn analysis and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: cancellation_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text feedback provided by the player at the time of cancellation. Provides qualitative insights into churn drivers and player sentiment.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the player for cancelling the subscription. Used for churn analysis, product improvement, and retention strategy development.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription complies with COPPA requirements for players under 13 years of age. Used to enforce parental consent and data collection restrictions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the subscription price. Used for multi-currency reporting and revenue normalization.

attributes.name: current_billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the current billing cycle. The next renewal or cancellation will occur on or before this date.

attributes.name: current_billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the current billing cycle. Used to calculate prorated charges, usage windows, and renewal timing.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied to the subscription price. Null if no discount was applied. Used for net revenue calculation and promotion cost analysis.

attributes.name: discount_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotional discount or coupon was applied to this subscription. Used for promotion effectiveness analysis and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: The promotional code or coupon code applied to the subscription. Null if no discount was applied. Used for campaign attribution and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the subscription price. Null if no discount was applied or if discount was a fixed amount. Used for promotion effectiveness reporting.

attributes.name: entitlement_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player currently has access to the subscription entitlements. May be false even if subscription status is active, due to payment failures or grace period expiration.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_given
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Consent Given Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR requirements. Required for players in EU jurisdictions.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the grace period for payment retry ends. After this date, the subscription will be suspended or cancelled if payment is not successful. Null if no grace period is active.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: last_payment_failure_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent payment failure. Null if no payment failures have occurred. Used for dunning workflow triggers and grace period calculation.

attributes.name: lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: The total revenue generated from this subscription since inception, including all billing cycles. Used for LTV (Lifetime Value) calculation and whale segmentation.

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: The date when the next subscription charge will be processed. Null if subscription is cancelled or not set to auto-renew.

attributes.name: payment_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of times payment processing has failed for this subscription. Used for involuntary churn risk scoring and dunning campaign targeting.

attributes.name: payment_method_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the payment method used for recurring billing. The token is provided by the payment processor and does not contain actual card numbers, ensuring PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: The payment processor or platform storefront that handles billing for this subscription. Determines reconciliation process, fee structure, and refund policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stripe|paypal|apple_iap|google_play|steam|epic_games|console_first_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: The referral code used by the player when subscribing, if applicable. Links to the referring player for K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) calculation and referral reward distribution.

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription is scheduled to end or did end. Null for active subscriptions with auto-renewal enabled. Populated for cancelled or expired subscriptions.

attributes.name: subscription_price
attributes.description: The recurring price charged for the subscription per billing cycle. Stored in the currency specified in the currency_code field. Used for ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) and ARPPU (Average Revenue Per Paying User) calculations.

attributes.name: subscription_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this subscription originated. New player indicates first subscription at account creation. Existing player upgrade indicates conversion from free-to-play. Reactivation indicates return of a previously churned subscriber. Cross-sell indicates purchase of an additional subscription product.

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription became active and entitlements were first granted to the player. Used to calculate subscription age and LTV (Lifetime Value).

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription. Active indicates the subscription is in good standing and entitlements are available. Trial indicates the player is in a trial period. Paused indicates temporary suspension by player request. Cancelled indicates the player has terminated the subscription. Expired indicates the subscription ended due to non-renewal. Suspended indicates administrative hold due to payment failure or policy violation.

attributes.name: subscription_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of the subscription plan, indicating the scope of entitlements and benefits. Used for segmentation and upsell targeting.

attributes.name: trial_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the trial period ended and the subscription converted to paid status. Null if no trial was used or trial is still active.

attributes.name: trial_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the trial period began. Null if no trial was used for this subscription.

attributes.name: trial_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has used a trial period for this subscription plan. Used to enforce one-trial-per-player business rules and prevent trial abuse.

products.name: dlc_entitlement
products.description: Transactional record of a player's ownership of a specific DLC (Downloadable Content) or expansion pack. Captures player reference, DLC SKU reference, acquisition method (purchased, gifted, promotional, bundle), acquisition timestamp, platform storefront, license key token, download status, and revocation flag. The SSOT for DLC ownership rights — distinct from the MTX catalog definition.

attributes.name: dlc_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DLC entitlement record. Primary key.

The entitlement must reference the cert that authorized the sale in t

attributes.name: asset_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset_bundle. Business justification: DLC entitlements unlock specific asset bundles for download. Core DLC delivery process requires linking entitlement to downloadable content package for CDN access and installation.

attributes.name: campaign_id

products.name: plan_content_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of DLC content within subscription plan libraries. It captures which DLC entitlements are available to subscribers of each plan, when content enters or exits the library, access restrictions, and exclusivity arrangements. Each record links one subscription_plan to one DLC content offering with attributes that govern subscriber access rights and content lifecycle within the subscription service.. Existence Justification: In gaming subscription services (Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, EA Play model), subscription plans include curated libraries of DLC content, where each plan tier includes multiple DLC items and each DLC can be included across multiple subscription tiers with different access levels. The business actively manages content library composition, tracking when content enters/exits plans, enforcing tier-specific access rules, and managing exclusivity arrangements. This is an operational M:N relationship representing subscription content library management.

products.name: cert_submission
products.description: Transactional record of the complete platform certification lifecycle from build preparation and packaging through formal platform holder submission, review, and outcome resolution. At the build level: captures build version string, build type (debug, release candidate, gold master, patch, hotfix), target platform, build size (bytes), build hash/checksum, submission pipeline status (packaging, uploading, validating, submitted, in-review, approved, rejected), submission channel (PlayStation DevNet, Xbox Partner Center, App Store Connect, Steamworks), and gold master flag. At the submission level: captures TRC/TCR checklist version applied, submission type (initial, resubmission, patch), and platform holder review tracking. At the result level: captures certification outcome per review cycle (pass, fail, conditional pass), failure count and categories, waiver grants, resubmission deadline, certification certificate ID, gold master approval flag, and platform holder reviewer notes. One submission may have multiple result records across resubmission cycles. This is the SSOT for the entire build-to-certification pipeline including build preparation, formal submission, and all platform holder review outcomes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

True indicates a waiver was granted allowing certification despite non-compliance, false indicates no waivers were needed or granted.

products.name: drm_entitlement
products.description: Master and transactional record governing DRM (Digital Rights Management) entitlement rules and the complete audit trail of individual player-level access grants for platform SKUs. At the rule level: captures entitlement type (purchase, subscription, trial, F2P, rental), license scope (single-device, multi-device, family share), offline play allowance, region lock configuration, expiry rules, and revocation policy. At the grant level: tracks individual player entitlement grants including grant timestamp, source transaction reference (IAP, promotion, subscription, key redemption), platform account ID, device binding, grant channel (storefront purchase, key redemption, promotional grant, subscription benefit), grant expiry, and revocation status. This is the SSOT for both DRM licensing policy definitions and the complete audit trail of player access rights across all platforms. Supports entitlement verification, access revocation, and compliance audit queries.

attributes.description: The type of entitlement governing access rights. Purchase = permanent ownership, Subscription = recurring access, Trial = time-limited evaluation, F2P = free-to-play access, Rental = temporary paid access, Promotional = marketing grant.

attributes.name: expiry_fixed_date

attributes.name: expiry_rule

attributes.name: grant_channel

Storefront-purchase = direct store purchase, Key-redemption = activation code, Promotional-grant = marketing campaign, Subscription-benefit = included in subscription, Bundle-inclusion = part of bundle purchase, Platform-plus = platform subscription service (PS Plus, Game Pass).

attributes.name: grant_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The calculated date and time when this specific entitlement grant expires. Computed based on grant_timestamp and expiry_rule configuration. Null for perpetual entitlements.

attributes.name: grant_source_transaction_reference

attributes.name: region_lock_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic region restrictions apply to this entitlement. True = region-locked, False = globally accessible.

attributes.name: revocation_grace_period_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of continued access after revocation is triggered. Applicable only when revocation_policy is grace_period. Null for other policies.

attributes.name: revocation_policy
attributes.description: Defines the policy for revoking this entitlement. Immediate = access removed instantly, Grace-period = access continues for defined period, Non-revocable = cannot be revoked once granted.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this entitlement was revoked. Chargeback = payment reversed, Fraud = fraudulent acquisition detected, Policy-violation = terms of service breach, Subscription-cancellation = subscription ended, Refund = purchase refunded, Admin-action = manual revocation by support.

attributes.name: revocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this entitlement grant. Active = valid and usable, Revoked = access removed by admin/system, Suspended = temporarily disabled, Expired = past expiry timestamp.

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this entitlement was revoked or suspended. Null if revocation_status is active or expired.

attributes.name: transfer_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement can be transferred to another player account. True = transferable, False = non-transferable. Most digital entitlements are non-transferable per platform policies.

attributes.name: verification_required_interval_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between required online entitlement verification checks. Applicable for entitlements that allow offline play but require periodic online check-ins. Null for always-online or fully-offline entitlements.

Draft indicates unsigned or pending approval; active indicates in force; suspended indicates temporarily paused; terminated indicates ended before expiration; expired indicates naturally ended; completed indicates fulfilled all terms.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract governing the player-team relationship. Standard contracts are full-time competitive agreements; loan contracts are temporary assignments from another team; trial contracts are probationary periods; academy contracts are for developmental rosters; substitute contracts are for backup players; free agent contracts are short-term engagements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The agreed-upon mechanism for resolving contractual disputes between player and team, including arbitration, mediation, litigation, or league-administered tribunal.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for indefinite contracts.

attributes.name: equipment_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides gaming equipment (PC, peripherals, etc.) to the player as part of the contract.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause
attributes.description: Terms requiring the player to compete exclusively for this team and prohibiting simultaneous contracts with other esports organizations.

attributes.name: health_insurance_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides health insurance coverage for the player as part of the contract benefits.

attributes.name: housing_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides housing accommodations for the player as part of the contract terms.

attributes.name: image_rights_terms
attributes.description: Terms governing the use of the players name, likeness, and image in marketing, merchandise, and promotional materials, including revenue sharing and approval rights.

attributes.name: non_compete_terms
attributes.description: Textual description of restrictions on the player competing for rival teams or in competing leagues during and after the contract period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract details, special clauses, or internal annotations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the contract without penalty.

attributes.name: performance_bonus_structure
attributes.description: Textual description of the performance-based bonus terms, including tournament placement bonuses, MVP awards, and other achievement-based incentives.

attributes.name: relocation_assistance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount provided to the player to cover relocation expenses when joining the team, if applicable.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: The duration in months for which the contract will automatically renew if auto-renewal is enabled.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of team revenue (e.g., prize winnings, sponsorship, merchandise) that the player is entitled to receive under this contract. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: salary_amount
attributes.description: The base annual salary paid to the player under this contract, excluding bonuses and revenue share.

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the salary amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was signed by all parties, establishing legal commitment.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract becomes effective and the player is officially bound to the team.

attributes.name: streaming_rights_restrictions
attributes.description: Contractual limitations on the players ability to stream gameplay, including platform exclusivity, content restrictions, and revenue sharing for streaming income.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Null if contract was not terminated early.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for early contract termination, including mutual agreement, breach of contract, performance issues, or organizational restructuring.

attributes.name: tournament_participation_requirements
attributes.description: Contractual obligations regarding minimum tournament participation, practice schedules, and competitive availability requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or virtual venue where this bracket stage is being held. Null for fully online brackets. Used for logistics, ticketing, and broadcast production planning.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the final match of this bracket stage actually concluded. Used for operational tracking, broadcast analytics, and schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: advancement_rule

Examples: 'Top 2 teams advance', 'Winner advances to upper bracket, loser to lower bracket', 'Top 4 by points qualify for playoffs'. Free-text field capturing the specific progression logic for this bracket.

attributes.name: average_minute_audience
attributes.description: The average number of viewers watching at any given minute during this bracket stage. Standard broadcast metric used for advertising rate calculations and sponsorship deliverables.

attributes.name: best_of_format
