attributes.name: platform_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.platform_sku. Business justification: Community events are tied to specific SKU editions — launch events for Deluxe Edition SKUs, beta events for specific platform SKUs, or early access events. Marketing and community teams need this link

attributes.name: playable_character_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.playable_character. Business justification: Character anniversary events, character reveal community events, and character-spotlight tournaments are a named community management process. The event planning workflow links events to the featured

attributes.name: player_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.player_segment. Business justification: Community events target specific player segments (competitive tournaments for hardcore, social events for casual, tutorial events for new players). Studios design events for segment engagement, retent

attributes.name: release_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.release_schedule. Business justification: Launch events, tournaments, and content drops are coordinated with release schedules. Marketing and community teams need to sync event timing with platform approval dates, embargo lifts, and preorder

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform (console, PC, mobile) on which this community event is hosted or accessible.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why the community event was cancelled or postponed. Populated only when event_status is 'cancelled' or 'postponed'. Used for post-mortem analysis and player communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this community event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: The Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) collected from participants after the community event, typically on a 1-5 scale. Measures overall satisfaction with the event experience. Sourced from Zendesk post-event surveys.
attributes.references: Zendesk CSAT Module; IGDA Community Management Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the requirements a player must meet to participate in the event (e.g., minimum account level, geographic restrictions, age requirements, game ownership). Supports COPPA and GDPR compliance for age-gated events.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the community event officially closes and participation is no longer accepted.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the community event, used in marketing materials, URLs, and cross-system references (e.g., 'CE-SUMFAN24').

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the community event including objectives, rules, theme, and any special instructions for participants. Displayed on community portals and in-game event hubs.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Official display name of the community event as shown to players and community members (e.g., 'Summer Fan Art Contest 2024', 'Developer AMA — Season 5 Launch').

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the community event. Controls visibility, registration availability, and operational workflows. Values: upcoming (scheduled, not yet started), active (currently running), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated before completion), postponed (rescheduled), draft (not yet published).

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the community event by its format and purpose. Drives eligibility rules, prize structures, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_game_challenge|fan_tournament|developer_ama|community_contest|seasonal_campaign|community_challenge|ugc_submission|charity_stream — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: external_url
attributes.description: The public-facing URL for the community event landing page, registration portal, or official announcement. Used in marketing campaigns, in-game notifications, and community portal links.

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event has age-based eligibility restrictions (e.g., 18+ for prize-bearing contests). Triggers additional COPPA/GDPR compliance workflows when True.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event is designated as a featured or promoted event, receiving elevated visibility on community portals, in-game hubs, and marketing channels.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event is part of a recurring series (e.g., weekly community challenges, annual seasonal campaigns). When True, recurrence_pattern provides scheduling details.

attributes.name: k_factor_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether viral referral and K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) tracking is enabled for this community event. When True, referral attribution data is captured to measure the event's organic growth and word-of-mouth amplification.

attributes.name: max_registrations
attributes.description: The maximum number of players or teams allowed to register for this community event. Null indicates unlimited registrations. Used for capacity planning and waitlist management.

attributes.name: min_player_level
attributes.description: The minimum in-game player level or rank required to be eligible to participate in this community event. Null indicates no level restriction.

attributes.name: moderation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether player submissions or participation in this event requires human or automated content moderation review before being published or counted. Critical for UGC events and community contests.
attributes.references: IGDA Community Management Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act; FTC

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score (NPS) collected from participants after the community event concludes, ranging from -100 to 100. Measures player satisfaction and likelihood to recommend the event. Sourced from post-event surveys.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Zendesk CSAT/NPS Module

attributes.name: organizer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity organizing the event. Distinguishes first-party developer-run events from community-led or third-party organized events, which affects moderation requirements and prize liability.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: The total number of players or teams that actively participated in the community event (distinct from registrations, which may include no-shows). Key metric for community engagement reporting.

attributes.name: prize_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of prizes, rewards, or incentives offered to participants or winners of the community event (e.g., 'Exclusive in-game cosmetic skin, 1000 virtual currency, and a physical trophy for top 3 finishers').
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guidelines; Internal Monetization Policy

attributes.name: prize_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary prize category offered in this community event. Drives tax reporting obligations and prize fulfillment workflows. Virtual prizes (MTX items, virtual currency) are distinguished from physical or cash prizes for regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; PCI DSS (if cash prizes)

attributes.name: prize_value_usd
attributes.description: The total declared monetary value of all prizes for this community event in US Dollars. Required for tax reporting, legal compliance, and prize pool disclosures. Applies to both cash and fair-market-value of physical/virtual prizes.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; IRS Prize Reporting Requirements; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: The frequency pattern for recurring community events. Null for one-time events. Used for automated event scheduling and community calendar management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|seasonal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referral_count
attributes.description: The total number of new player registrations attributed to referrals from existing participants in this community event. Used to calculate the K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) and measure organic community growth.

attributes.name: registration_close_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when player registration for the community event closes. After this point, no new registrations are accepted.

attributes.name: registration_count
attributes.description: The current total number of players or teams that have registered for this community event. Updated in near-real-time from the registration system.

attributes.name: registration_open_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when player registration for the community event opens. May precede the event start timestamp to allow advance sign-ups.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Concise summary of the community event (max 280 characters) used in promotional banners, push notifications, and social media previews.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the community event officially begins and becomes active for player participation.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The type of submission or participation action required from players in this community event. Determines the UGC (User-Generated Content) moderation workflow and submission portal configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ugc_artwork|ugc_video|ugc_screenshot|gameplay_score|leaderboard|vote|registration_only|written_entry — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IGDA Community Management Standards; GDPR Article 6 (UGC consent)

attributes.name: survey_response_count
attributes.description: The total number of post-event survey responses received from participants. Provides the denominator context for interpreting NPS and CSAT scores.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this community event record was last modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit compliance.

attributes.name: voting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether community members can vote on submissions or outcomes in this event (e.g., fan art contests with community voting). Drives the voting module configuration.

products.name: social_connection
products.description: Association entity representing social graph relationships between players including friends, followers, and blocked connections. Tracks initiating player reference, target player reference, connection type (friend/follower/blocked/muted), connection status (pending/accepted/declined/removed), connection source (in-game/forum/guild/external), and connection established/updated timestamps. SSOT for player social graph within the community domain.

attributes.name: social_connection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each social graph relationship record between two players. Primary key for the social_connection entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or referral campaign that drove this social connection, when applicable. Supports K-Factor viral coefficient measurement and player acquisition attribution via AppsFlyer/Adjust.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer/Adjust Marketing Attribution; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_policy. Business justification: Friend connections require consent for data sharing (online status, activity feeds, cross-game presence) under GDPR Article 6 and COPPA parental consent. Links gdpr_consent_flag to formal policy versi

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title context in which this social connection was established, if applicable. Null for platform-level or cross-game connections.

attributes.name: guild_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guild or clan through which this social connection was established, when connection_source is 'guild'. Null for connections originating from other sources.

attributes.name: moderation_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to community.moderation_action. Business justification: social_connection carries moderation_flag: STRING — a denormalized indicator that the connection has been flagged for moderation. Adding social_connection.moderation_action_id → moderation_action.mode

attributes.name: primary_social_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who originated or initiated the social connection request (the source node in the social graph). Used to determine directionality of the relationship.

attributes.name: target_player_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who is the recipient or target of the social connection request (the destination node in the social graph). Used to determine directionality of the relationship.

attributes.name: block_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code provided by the initiating player when blocking the target player. Populated only when connection_type is 'blocked'. Supports community safety analytics and moderation reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Community Safety Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: co_play_session_count
attributes.description: Number of game sessions in which both the initiating and target players participated together since the connection was established. Key metric for measuring social engagement depth and retention correlation.

attributes.name: connection_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the social relationship is unidirectional (e.g., follower, blocked, muted — only the initiating player's perspective applies) or bidirectional (e.g., mutual friend where both parties have accepted).

attributes.name: connection_label
attributes.description: Optional free-text label or nickname assigned by the initiating player to categorize or personalize this connection (e.g., 'Raid Team', 'IRL Friend', 'Clan Leader'). Supports player-defined social graph organization.

attributes.name: connection_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the social connection record, used for support, audit, and operational reference. Format: SC- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: connection_source
attributes.description: The channel or surface through which the social connection was initiated. Supports attribution analysis for community growth and K-Factor viral coefficient measurement. Values: in_game (initiated during gameplay), forum (community forum), guild (guild/clan membership), external (external social platform import), platform (console or PC platform friend list).
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: connection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the social connection. 'pending' means the request has been sent but not yet acted upon; 'accepted' means the connection is active; 'declined' means the target player rejected the request; 'removed' means a previously accepted connection was dissolved.

attributes.name: connection_strength_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the strength or closeness of the social connection based on interaction frequency, co-play sessions, and engagement signals. Used in community analytics, recommendation engines, and K-Factor viral coefficient modeling.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: connection_tier
attributes.description: Player-assigned or system-inferred tier classifying the closeness of the social relationship. Used for prioritized content feeds, notification filtering, and social graph segmentation in community analytics.

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the social relationship between the two players. 'friend' indicates a mutual bidirectional relationship; 'follower' indicates a unidirectional follow; 'blocked' indicates the initiating player has blocked the target; 'muted' indicates the initiating player has silenced the target without blocking.

attributes.name: connection_version
attributes.description: Optimistic locking version counter incremented on each update to the social connection record. Supports concurrent update conflict detection and Silver Layer SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Modeling Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this social connection record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the business event timestamps (request_sent_timestamp, established_timestamp).

attributes.name: established_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the social connection transitioned to an active/accepted state. Represents the real-world business event time of the connection being formed. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether valid GDPR consent has been obtained from both players for processing their social connection data, applicable for players in EU jurisdictions. Required for compliance with GDPR supervisory authority reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: interaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of social interactions (messages, co-play sessions, gift exchanges, reactions) recorded between the two players since the connection was established. Raw signal used for connection strength scoring and community engagement analytics.

attributes.name: is_cross_game
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection spans multiple game titles within the platform ecosystem, as opposed to being scoped to a single game title. Supports cross-title community analytics.

attributes.name: is_favorite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initiating player has marked this connection as a favorite or best friend, enabling prioritized display and notification preferences within the social graph.

attributes.name: is_minor_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection involves at least one player identified as a minor, triggering COPPA-compliant restrictions on social features, messaging, and data processing.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC — Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); GDPR Article 8 (Child Consent)

attributes.name: is_mutual
attributes.description: Indicates whether the social connection is bidirectional and mutually acknowledged by both players. True for accepted friend relationships; False for unidirectional follower, blocked, or muted connections.

attributes.name: is_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection or an interaction within it has been flagged via a player report. Links community safety monitoring to the social graph for moderation workflow prioritization.
attributes.references: Internal Community Moderation Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: k_factor_contribution
attributes.description: Numeric value representing this social connection's contribution to the K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) calculation, measuring how effectively connected players invite or recruit new players. Used in player acquisition and community growth analytics.
attributes.references: K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology; AppsFlyer/Adjust Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: last_interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent social interaction between the two connected players. Used to identify dormant connections, calculate connection recency, and support churn prediction models.

attributes.name: mute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code provided by the initiating player when muting the target player. Populated only when connection_type is 'muted'. Supports community health and player experience analytics.

attributes.name: notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initiating player has enabled activity notifications for this specific social connection (e.g., when the connected player goes online, achieves a milestone, or posts content).

attributes.name: nps_influence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection was established as a result of an NPS (Net Promoter Score) promoter referral, linking community satisfaction data to social graph growth for player advocacy analytics.
attributes.references: NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The gaming platform on which the social connection was initiated. Supports cross-platform social graph analysis and platform-specific community health reporting. Aligned with Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDK platform identifiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX|SWITCH|MOBILE|WEB — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Console Platform SDK

attributes.name: privacy_visibility
attributes.description: Privacy setting controlling who can see this social connection in the player's social graph. 'public' allows all players to see the connection; 'friends_only' restricts visibility to mutual friends; 'private' hides the connection entirely.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design); COPPA (FTC)

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction

attributes.name: appeal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the appeal reviewer documenting the rationale for the appeal outcome. Supports audit trails and policy consistency reviews.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision on the player's appeal. 'upheld' means the original ban stands; 'overturned' means the ban is reversed; 'modified' means the ban terms were changed (e.g., duration reduced); 'withdrawn' means the player withdrew the appeal before resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: appeal_resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appeal review was completed and a final outcome was recorded. Null if appeal is still pending or not submitted. Used to measure appeal resolution time and SLA adherence.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the player's appeal against this ban. 'not_appealed' means no appeal has been submitted; 'pending' means appeal submitted but not yet reviewed; 'under_review' means actively being reviewed; 'upheld' means ban confirmed; 'overturned' means ban reversed; 'withdrawn' means player withdrew the appeal.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 22 (right to contest automated decisions)

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player submitted their appeal against this ban. Null if no appeal has been filed. Used to track appeal SLA compliance.

attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; Internal AI/ML Governance Standard

attributes.name: ban_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for this ban (e.g., BAN-202400012345). Used in player communications, appeal correspondence, and support tickets.

attributes.name: ban_scope
attributes.description: The community feature area(s) to which this ban applies. 'forum' restricts forum posting; 'chat' restricts in-game and community chat; 'ugc' restricts User-Generated Content (UGC) submissions; 'all_community' applies a full community ban across all features.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: ban_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the community ban. 'active' means the ban is currently enforced; 'expired' means the ban end date has passed; 'lifted' means the ban was manually removed; 'appealed' means an appeal is in progress; 'pending_review' means the ban is under internal review.

attributes.name: ban_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ban duration model. 'temporary' bans have a defined end date; 'permanent' bans have no end date (null ban_end_timestamp); 'shadow' bans restrict visibility without notifying the player, used for spam and bot suppression.

attributes.name: content_rating_concern
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation underlying this ban involved content that may affect the game's content rating classification (e.g., extreme violence, sexual content, hate speech). Flags for escalation to the content compliance team for ESRB/PEGI review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this community ban record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (storage limitation and accountability); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: The originally assigned duration of the ban in hours at the time of issuance. Null for permanent bans. Enables duration-based analytics and policy benchmarking independent of actual start/end timestamps.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ban is scheduled to expire. Null for permanent bans (ban_type = 'permanent'). When the current timestamp exceeds this value, ban_status transitions to 'expired'.

attributes.name: evidence_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of evidence files (screenshots, chat logs, video clips) attached to this ban record to substantiate the violation. Supports audit completeness checks and appeal review.

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: is_automated

attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making)

attributes.name: is_minor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the banned player is identified as a minor (under 18, or under 13 for COPPA purposes). Triggers enhanced data handling, parental notification workflows, and stricter enforcement protocols.

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ban is permanent with no scheduled end date. True when ban_type is 'permanent' and ban_end_timestamp is null. Provides a direct boolean filter for permanent ban analytics and enforcement dashboards.

attributes.name: is_repeat_offender
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player was classified as a repeat offender at the time of ban issuance (prior_ban_count > 0 or per policy threshold). Drives escalated enforcement actions and permanent ban eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player was notified of this ban via the standard communication channel (in-game notification, email, or support ticket). Supports compliance with consumer protection notification requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ban notification was sent to the player. Null if notification_sent is False. Used to measure notification SLA compliance and support regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: prior_ban_count
attributes.description: Number of previous community bans on record for this player at the time this ban was issued. Supports repeat offender escalation policies and ban duration calibration.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific reason for issuing this ban, as documented by the moderator. Provides context beyond the structured violation category for audit and appeal review purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction

attributes.name: reinstatement_reason

attributes.name: reinstatement_timestamp

attributes.description: Assessed severity of the violation that triggered this ban. Drives escalation workflows, ban duration recommendations, and repeat offender policies.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this ban became effective and enforcement began. Principal business event timestamp for the ban lifecycle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this community ban record was last modified. Tracks any changes to ban status, appeal outcome, or reinstatement. Essential for Silver Layer incremental processing and audit trails.

attributes.name: violation_category

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: harassment|hate_speech|cheating|spam|inappropriate_content|impersonation|exploitation|other — promote to reference product]

products.name: attribution_record

This is the authoritative install attribution ledger for the marketing domain.

attributes.name: device_id

attributes.name: platform_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.platform_sku. Business justification: Attribution records must identify which platform SKU was installed to calculate accurate CPI and ROAS by SKU edition. Distinguishing F2P SKU installs from premium SKU installs is essential for UA budg

attributes.name: telemetry_event_id

attributes.name: ad_set_name

attributes.name: app_code

attributes.name: app_name

attributes.name: attribution_platform

attributes.name: attribution_platform_record_reference

attributes.name: attribution_timestamp

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: cpi_usd

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: install_type

attributes.name: media_source

attributes.name: os_name

attributes.name: os_version

attributes.name: spend_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: launch_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.launch_event. Business justification: retention_cohort carries is_soft_launch: BOOLEAN indicating whether the cohort was acquired during a soft launch. Adding launch_event_id links the cohort directly to the specific launch event, enablin

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total marketing spend attributed to acquiring this cohort. Used to calculate Cost Per Install (CPI) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: attribution_channel
attributes.description: The marketing channel through which players in this cohort were acquired (e.g., paid social, organic, influencer, affiliate, cross-promotion).

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The specific source or network within the attribution channel (e.g., Facebook, Google Ads, TikTok, organic App Store).

attributes.name: cohort_arppu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cohort Average Revenue Per Paying User (ARPPU)
attributes.description: Average revenue per paying user for this cohort, calculated as total revenue from the cohort divided by the number of paying users in the cohort. Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: cohort_arpu
attributes.description: Average revenue per user for this cohort, calculated as total revenue from the cohort divided by cohort size. Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: cohort_ltv_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated lifetime value per user for this cohort, projected based on observed revenue trends and retention curves. Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: cohort_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the retention cohort, typically combining install date, campaign, and channel for easy identification.

attributes.name: cohort_size
attributes.description: Total number of unique players who installed the game on the install date and are included in this cohort.

attributes.name: cohort_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cohort record. Active cohorts are still being tracked for retention metrics; mature cohorts have reached the end of the tracking window; archived cohorts are historical; under_review cohorts have data quality issues being investigated.

attributes.name: conversion_to_payer_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of users in this cohort who converted from free players to paying users, calculated as paying_users_count divided by cohort_size. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0523 for 5.23%).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic market where players in this cohort were acquired.

attributes.name: cpi
attributes.description: Average cost to acquire one user in this cohort, calculated as acquisition_cost divided by cohort_size. Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: d30_retained_players
attributes.description: Number of players from this cohort who returned to the game on Day 30 after install.

attributes.name: d30_retention_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of players from this cohort who returned on Day 30, calculated as d30_retained_players divided by cohort_size. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0823 for 8.23%).

attributes.name: d60_retained_players
attributes.description: Number of players from this cohort who returned to the game on Day 60 after install.

attributes.name: d60_retention_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of players from this cohort who returned on Day 60, calculated as d60_retained_players divided by cohort_size. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0512 for 5.12%).

attributes.name: d7_retained_players
attributes.description: Number of players from this cohort who returned to the game on Day 7 after install.

attributes.name: d7_retention_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of players from this cohort who returned on Day 7, calculated as d7_retained_players divided by cohort_size. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2145 for 21.45%).

attributes.name: d90_retained_players
attributes.description: Number of players from this cohort who returned to the game on Day 90 after install.

attributes.name: d90_retention_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of players from this cohort who returned on Day 90, calculated as d90_retained_players divided by cohort_size. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0345 for 3.45%).

attributes.name: dau_contribution
attributes.description: Average number of daily active users contributed by this cohort over the measurement period, representing the cohorts ongoing engagement impact.

attributes.name: install_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which players in this cohort first installed the game. This is the cohort anchor date used for retention calculations.

attributes.name: is_soft_launch
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this cohort was acquired during a soft launch phase (limited geographic or audience release) versus a hard launch (full public release).

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days since install date for which retention and revenue metrics have been measured for this cohort. Used to determine data maturity and projection confidence.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for marketing analysts to record observations, anomalies, or context about this cohort (e.g., impacted by holiday promotion, data quality issue on D7).

attributes.name: paying_users_count
attributes.description: Total number of users in this cohort who have made at least one in-app purchase or microtransaction.

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on ad spend for this cohort, calculated as total_revenue divided by acquisition_cost. Expressed as a ratio (e.g., 2.5000 means $2.50 revenue per $1.00 spent).

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue generated by all users in this cohort since install date. Expressed in the base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this retention cohort record was last updated with new retention or revenue metrics. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.description: The remaining unspent budget amount. Calculated as total_approved_budget_amount minus actual_spend_amount minus committed_amount.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the reason for the last budget revision (e.g., campaign performance exceeded expectations, reallocated from underperforming channel, additional funding approved for soft launch).

attributes.name: target_cpi
attributes.description: The target Cost Per Install (CPI) benchmark for this budget allocation. Used for pacing and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: target_d7_retention_rate
attributes.description: The target Day 7 retention rate (percentage) for players acquired under this budget allocation. Used to evaluate cohort quality.

attributes.name: target_roas
attributes.description: The target Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for this budget allocation. Expressed as a ratio (e.g., 3.5 means $3.50 revenue per $1 spent).

attributes.name: total_approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total budget amount approved by finance for this allocation. This is the authorized spending limit.

products.name: audience
products.description: Lookalike and custom audience definitions exported to ad platforms (Facebook, Google, TikTok) for paid UA targeting, capturing audience source segment, platform sync status, and match rates.

attributes.name: audience_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audience definition. Primary key.

attributes.name: ad_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.ad_network. Business justification: Audiences are exported to specific ad networks/platforms for activation. The target_platform STRING field (e.g., 'Facebook', 'Google', 'TikTok') should be normalized to a FK relationship to ad_network

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign this audience is primarily associated with for user acquisition targeting.

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_policy. Business justification: Audience sync to ad platforms requires consent policy validation before data export. Privacy compliance gate ensuring only consented players are shared with third-party advertising networks.

attributes.name: funnel_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.funnel_definition. Business justification: Audiences are built to optimize specific conversion funnels (install-to-FTU, tutorial-to-retention, browse-to-purchase). Funnel drop-off analysis identifies which player segments to target, and audien

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title this audience is associated with for targeting purposes.

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.league. Business justification: Marketing audiences built from league viewership data (e.g., LCS viewers, Worlds watchers) for retargeting and lookalike modeling. League context enables precise audience segmentation and activation f

attributes.name: player_behavior_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.player_behavior_segment. Business justification: Audiences for lookalike targeting are often seeded from ML-driven behavior segments (high-LTV, churn-risk). Distinct from rule-based player_segment; enables tracking which ML segments drive best acqui

attributes.name: player_ltv_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.player_ltv_segment. Business justification: Marketing audiences for UA platforms are built from LTV segments for lookalike modeling and value-based bidding. Linking enables audience sync from monetization data, high-value player targeting in pa

attributes.name: player_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player segment that serves as the seed or source population for this audience definition.

attributes.name: processing_activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.processing_activity. Business justification: Audience creation and sync to third-party ad platforms is a processing activity requiring GDPR Article 30 documentation. Required for data protection impact assessments and third-party processor manag

attributes.name: source_audience_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on audience (source_audience_id)

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront. Business justification: Audiences are built and activated on specific platform storefronts (Steam audience vs App Store audience). The existing 'platform_scope' text is a denormalization. A direct FK enables audience activat

attributes.name: subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.subscription_plan. Business justification: Marketing audiences are built from subscription plan holders (e.g., 'all Game Pass subscribers' for upsell campaigns, 'trial users' for conversion campaigns). Gaming marketing teams need this FK to de

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.team. Business justification: Team-fan lookalike audiences built from team follower data are a standard esports paid acquisition tactic. audience already has league_id but lacks team-level scoping needed for team-specific audience

attributes.name: title_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_season. Business justification: 'Seasonal audience construction for retargeting' — building lookalike and retargeting audiences from players active in Season 3 — is a core GaaS UA process. audience has no title_season_id; this FK en

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this audience was first activated and synced to the target ad platform.

attributes.name: att_opt_in_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience is restricted to iOS users who have granted ATT opt-in consent for tracking.

attributes.name: audience_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or short code for the audience used in external systems and reporting.

attributes.name: audience_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the audience segment (e.g., 'High-LTV Whales Q1 2024', 'D7 Churned Non-Payers').

attributes.name: audience_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audience: draft (being built), active (syncing to platforms), paused (temporarily disabled), archived (no longer used), expired (past validity window).

attributes.name: audience_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audience definition method: lookalike (modeled from seed), custom (manually defined), behavioral (action-based), demographic (attribute-based), value_based (LTV/ARPU tier), or retargeting (re-engagement).

attributes.name: average_d7_retention_rate
attributes.description: Average day-7 retention rate (percentage) of players in the source segment. Used to assess audience quality for lookalike modeling.

attributes.name: average_ltv_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Lifetime Value (LTV) United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Average lifetime value in USD of players in the source segment used to build this audience. Used for value-based lookalike modeling.

attributes.name: coppa_exclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Exclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether users under age 13 (or applicable age threshold) are excluded from this audience to comply with COPPA requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audience record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days this audience data will be retained on the ad platform before automatic deletion, per privacy policy and platform limits.

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: Ad platform's estimated reachable audience size based on the matched identifiers and platform's user base. Provided by platform API.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this audience definition expires and should no longer be used for targeting. Null if no expiration.

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: Legal basis under GDPR for processing and exporting this audience data: consent, legitimate_interest, contract, legal_obligation, or not_applicable (non-EU audience).

attributes.name: geo_target_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of 3-letter ISO country codes where this audience is targeted (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR'). Empty if global.

attributes.name: hashing_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to hash PII identifiers before export (SHA256, MD5, or none for non-PII identifiers).

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: Type of player identifier used for matching with ad platforms: email (hashed), phone (hashed), device_id, IDFA (iOS), GAID (Android), or internal player_id.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audience record was last modified or refreshed.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful or attempted sync to the target ad platform.

attributes.name: lookalike_expansion_percentage
attributes.description: Expansion factor for lookalike modeling (e.g., 1% = most similar, 10% = broader reach). Null for non-lookalike audiences.

attributes.name: lookalike_seed_size
attributes.description: Number of seed users used to generate a lookalike audience. Null for non-lookalike audience types.

attributes.name: match_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of audience members successfully matched by the ad platform (matched_count / audience_size * 100). Key metric for audience quality and targeting effectiveness.

attributes.name: matched_count
attributes.description: Number of player identifiers successfully matched and accepted by the ad platform during last sync.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the next automatic sync to the ad platform is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this audience definition, including business context, targeting strategy, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: platform_audience_reference
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the ad platform (e.g., Facebook Custom Audience ID, Google Audience ID) after successful sync.

attributes.name: platform_scope
attributes.description: Device platform scope for this audience: iOS, Android, web, console, or cross_platform (all platforms).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Total number of unique player identifiers included in this audience definition at last refresh.

attributes.name: suppression_list_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a suppression list (e.g., opted-out users, existing players) has been applied to exclude certain identifiers from this audience.

attributes.name: sync_error_message
attributes.description: Error message returned by the ad platform if the last sync attempt failed. Null if sync was successful.

attributes.name: sync_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the audience is refreshed and re-synced to the ad platform: real_time, hourly, daily, weekly, or manual (on-demand only).

attributes.name: sync_status
attributes.description: Current synchronization status with the target ad platform: pending (queued), syncing (in progress), synced (complete), failed (error), partial (some records failed).

domains.name: licensing
domains.description: Manages IP licensing, game engine technology licensing (Unity/Unreal SDK deals), third-party middleware agreements, music/art asset licensing, franchise/brand partnership contracts, royalty calculation schedules, licensee entitlements, and compliance with IP ownership terms and rating board requirements. Supports both outbound engine licensing revenue and inbound licensed IP usage.

products.name: iap_transaction
products.description: Core transactional record of every In-App Purchase (IAP) event executed by a player across all platforms (iOS, Android, console, PC storefronts). Captures SKU purchased (FK to mtx_catalog), gross/net revenue, storefront, payment method, currency, exchange rate, platform fee, net proceeds, refund eligibility window, receipt token, transaction status, and offer attribution (offer_campaign_id, discount applied, F2P conversion flag). The authoritative SSOT for individual IAP revenue events — distinct from billing domain payment processing records. Feeds ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, and offer conversion rate calculations.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each In-App Purchase (IAP) transaction event recorded in the monetization platform. Globally unique across all platforms and storefronts. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: IAP transactions occur within specific game builds. Tracking build version at purchase time is critical for fraud detection (exploit identification by build), A/B test attribution, platform certificat

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Track which content version was live during purchase for customer support, refund handling, and version-specific entitlement issues. Critical for troubleshooting IAP problems post-patch.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title within which the IAP transaction was executed. Enables per-title revenue reporting and cross-title monetization analysis.

attributes.name: granted_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Direct asset purchases (character skins, weapon skins) via IAP require linking transaction to granted content for entitlement tracking, refund processing, and inventory management.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: IAP transactions generate invoices for revenue recognition, tax compliance, and financial reporting. Gaming companies must reconcile IAP revenue with invoices for audit trails and regulatory filings (

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Every IAP transaction occurs in a specific regulatory jurisdiction determining tax treatment, age restrictions, loot box regulations, and revenue recognition rules. Essential for regional compliance r

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.league. Business justification: IAP transactions attributed to league events (e.g., purchases during league broadcast, league-branded item sales) require league-level revenue attribution for financial reporting and IP royalty calcul

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: IAP transactions for licensed content (Marvel characters, Star Wars items) require IP attribution for royalty calculation and revenue reporting to licensors. Critical for automated royalty accrual in

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the MTX catalog entry representing the SKU purchased (e.g., virtual currency pack, DLC, battle pass, loot box, cosmetic item). Authoritative link to the item definition and pricing.

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional offer or marketing campaign that was active at the time of purchase. Used to measure offer conversion rates and discount attribution. Nullable when no campaign was applied.
attributes.references: Internal Campaign Management Standard; AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Every IAP transaction has a corresponding payment record for settlement reconciliation, chargeback disputes, and refund processing. Payment gateway integration requires linking transactions to payment

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player who executed the IAP transaction. Links to the player master record. Supports ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, LTV, and whale segmentation analytics. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; COPPA (FTC); Internal Player Identity Standard

attributes.name: purchased_asset_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset_bundle. Business justification: When players purchase bundled content (season pass, cosmetic pack), transaction records need bundle reference for fulfillment verification, refund processing, customer support, and revenue attribution

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active game session during which the IAP transaction was initiated. Links purchase behavior to session context (session length, game mode, progression state) for behavioral monetization analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Player Behavior Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude

attributes.name: title_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_season. Business justification: Season-level IAP revenue reporting is a standard GaaS financial requirement. Publishers track revenue per season for live-ops ROI analysis, season pass conversion rates, and seasonal monetization benc

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Players purchase items during tournament viewing/participation. Tournament-driven IAP spikes are tracked for revenue attribution, promotional effectiveness analysis, and esports ROI measurement. Real

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The marketing channel or campaign source attributed to this IAP transaction by the mobile attribution platform (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust). Used for ROAS and CPI-to-LTV analysis. Examples: 'facebook_ads', 'google_uac', 'organic', 'influencer'. Null for non-attributed transactions.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution Standard; Internal Marketing Analytics Standard

attributes.name: bonus_virtual_currency
attributes.description: Additional virtual currency awarded as a promotional bonus on top of the base virtual_currency_awarded (e.g., first-purchase bonus, limited-time offer bonus). Null when no bonus applies. Supports offer effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Management Standard; Internal Offer Management Standard

attributes.name: coppa_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Age Verification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player's age was verified as meeting the minimum age requirement (13+ in the US) prior to this IAP transaction, per COPPA compliance requirements. True = age verification passed. Critical for regulatory compliance and audit trails involving minor players.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC); GDPR Article 8 (Children's Consent); Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IAP transaction record was first ingested into the Silver layer data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. May differ from purchased_at due to pipeline latency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the currency in which the player was charged (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component. Enables multi-currency revenue reporting and FX analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the player to execute the IAP transaction. Supports device-mix revenue analysis and platform-specific monetization strategy.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of any promotional discount or offer reduction applied to the gross amount at the time of purchase. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Zero when no discount was applied.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the gross price for this transaction (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.20 for 20% off). Derived from the offer campaign. Zero when no discount was applied. Supports offer ROI and conversion rate analysis.

attributes.name: entitlement_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchased item or virtual currency has been successfully delivered and credited to the player's account. True = entitlement fulfilled; False = pending or failed delivery. Critical for player support and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Entitlement Management Standard; Zendesk Player Support

attributes.name: entitlement_granted_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchased item or virtual currency was successfully delivered to the player's account. Enables latency measurement between payment confirmation and entitlement fulfillment. Null if entitlement has not yet been granted.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at the time of transaction to convert the transaction currency to the company's functional reporting currency (USD). Enables consistent cross-currency revenue aggregation and FX impact analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The full retail price charged to the player before any platform fees, taxes, or discounts are applied. Expressed in the transaction currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used as the basis for gross revenue reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 (Revenue Recognition); SAP S/4HANA SD Module; PCI DSS

attributes.name: is_f2p_conversion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IAP transaction represents the player's first-ever purchase, converting them from a Free-to-Play (F2P) non-payer to a paying player. True = first purchase / F2P conversion event. Critical for F2P conversion rate KPI and funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Internal F2P Monetization Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics

attributes.name: is_first_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the player's first IAP transaction within this specific game title (distinct from is_f2p_conversion which is cross-title). Supports per-title FTUE monetization analysis and first-purchase offer effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: is_whale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchasing player was classified as a 'whale' (high-spending player segment) at the time of this transaction, based on the company's LTV and spend segmentation model. Supports whale retention analysis and high-value player monetization reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Player Segmentation Standard; Internal LTV Model

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchased item by monetization category. Drives revenue mix reporting, P2W analysis, and regulatory compliance (e.g., loot box disclosure requirements). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: virtual_currency|dlc|battle_pass|loot_box|cosmetic|subscription|season_pass|consumable|durable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; PEGI; FTC Consumer Protection; Internal MTX Classification Standard

attributes.name: loot_box_regulatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IAP transaction involved a loot box or gacha mechanic subject to regulatory disclosure requirements (e.g., ESRB loot box labeling, Belgium/Netherlands gambling regulations). True = disclosure was presented to the player prior to purchase. Required for regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; PEGI; European Commission Digital Services Act; FTC Consumer Protection; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: net_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount received by the publisher after deducting platform fees, taxes, and discounts from the gross amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET net total component. Primary metric for ARPU and ARPPU net revenue calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Internal Revenue Recognition Policy

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used by the player to complete the IAP (e.g., credit card, PayPal, platform wallet, gift card). Distinct from payment_channel. Used for payment mix analysis and fraud detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|platform_wallet|gift_card|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The digital distribution platform or storefront through which the IAP was executed. Drives platform-specific revenue reporting, fee calculation, and certification compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ios|android|pc_steam|pc_epic|playstation|xbox|nintendo_switch|web — promote to reference product if additional platforms are added]
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Console SDK TRC/TCR Standards

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee retained by the platform storefront (e.g., Apple 30%, Google 15-30%, Steam 30%) deducted from gross revenue. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Critical for net proceeds and margin calculations.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; IFRS 15

attributes.name: platform_fee_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.30 for 30%) charged by the platform storefront on this transaction. Varies by platform, developer tier, and subscription program (e.g., Apple Small Business Program at 15%). Enables fee rate variance analysis.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK

attributes.name: player_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the player's registered billing country at the time of transaction. Used for geo-revenue reporting, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory compliance (GDPR, COPPA). Captured at transaction time to preserve historical accuracy.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; COPPA (FTC); PEGI; ESRB; Internal Tax Compliance Policy

attributes.name: player_level_at_purchase
attributes.description: The player's in-game progression level at the time of the IAP transaction. Enables purchase propensity analysis by progression stage and informs level-gated offer targeting strategies.

attributes.name: purchased_at
attributes.description: The precise real-world timestamp when the player initiated and confirmed the IAP purchase event on the storefront. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Primary time dimension for ARPU, ARPPU, and DAP calculations.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU purchased in this transaction. Typically 1 for most IAP events but may be greater for bundle purchases or multi-unit virtual currency packs.

attributes.name: receipt_token
attributes.description: Cryptographic receipt or validation token issued by the platform storefront to verify the authenticity of the IAP transaction (e.g., Apple App Store receipt, Google Play purchase token). Used for server-side receipt validation to prevent fraud and unauthorized entitlement grants.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; PCI DSS; Internal Anti-Fraud Standard

attributes.name: refund_eligible_until
attributes.description: The timestamp until which the player is eligible to request a refund for this IAP transaction, per platform policy and applicable consumer protection regulations. After this timestamp, refund requests may be declined. Null if the item is non-refundable.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; EU Consumer Rights Directive; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the refund when transaction_status is 'refunded'. Supports refund root-cause analysis and fraud detection. Null when no refund has been issued.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; FTC Consumer Protection; Internal Refund Policy

attributes.name: refunded_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when a refund was processed for this IAP transaction. Null if no refund has been issued. Used for refund rate tracking, revenue reversal accounting, and chargeback analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; PCI DSS

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds amount converted to the company's functional reporting currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at transaction time. Enables standardized global revenue aggregation for ARPU, ARPPU, and LTV calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Internal FX Policy

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The platform-specific SKU identifier for the purchased item as registered in the storefront (e.g., Apple App Store product ID, Google Play SKU, Steam item ID). Complements mtx_catalog_id with the external storefront identifier for reconciliation.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; Internal MTX Catalog Standard

attributes.name: storefront_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The externally-known transaction identifier issued by the platform storefront (e.g., Apple App Store order ID, Google Play order ID, Steam transaction ID, PlayStation Store transaction ID). BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for receipt validation, dispute resolution, and platform reconciliation.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; PCI DSS

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component (VAT, GST, sales tax) included in or added to the gross purchase amount, as applicable by jurisdiction. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Required for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IAP transaction. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. 'completed' = payment confirmed and entitlement granted; 'pending' = awaiting payment confirmation; 'failed' = payment declined or error; 'refunded' = reversal processed; 'disputed' = chargeback or player dispute raised; 'cancelled' = voided before completion.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this IAP transaction record (e.g., status change from pending to completed, refund processing). RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_awarded
attributes.description: The amount of in-game virtual currency (e.g., gems, coins, gold) credited to the player's account as a result of this IAP. Null for non-currency item purchases. Essential for virtual economy balance tracking and sink/source analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Management Standard; FTC Consumer Protection

products.name: virtual_currency_account
products.description: Master ledger account tracking a player's virtual currency balances across all in-game economies (hard currency, soft currency, premium tokens, event coins). Stores current balance, lifetime earned/spent totals, last transaction timestamp, currency type, game title scope, and account status. The SSOT for a player's virtual wallet state — distinct from real-money payment records in billing. Balances are reconcilable against virtual_currency_ledger entries.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the virtual currency account record. Primary key for the master ledger account tracking a player's virtual currency wallet state.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Player billing accounts track payment methods, fraud scores, and dunning status for virtual currency purchases. Linking VC accounts to billing accounts enables payment instrument management and fraud

attributes.name: economy_config_id
attributes.description: Reference to the virtual economy configuration that governs this account's currency rules, earn rates, spend caps, and exchange rates. Allows multiple economy configurations per game title (e.g., standard vs. event economy).

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that scopes this virtual currency account. A player may hold separate accounts per game title (e.g., separate wallets for different games in the portfolio).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Virtual currency accounts must track regulatory domicile for jurisdiction-specific compliance (China restrictions, EU consumer protection, tax reporting). Account-level jurisdiction needed for regulat

attributes.name: player_behavior_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.player_behavior_segment. Business justification: Currency account patterns (balance, earn/spend ratio, purchase frequency, currency type preference) are key segmentation features for player behavior models and monetization targeting.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution platform (e.g., PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, iOS, Android) on which this virtual currency account is registered. Platform scope determines applicable store policies, IAP processing rules, and certification requirements.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this virtual currency account was permanently closed or deactivated. Null for active accounts. Populated upon player account deletion, GDPR erasure request, or game title sunset.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Internal Monetization Standards

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the virtual currency account, used in player-facing support, reconciliation, and audit workflows. Distinct from the surrogate primary key.

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this virtual currency account was first created, typically coinciding with the player's first login or registration for the associated game title. Used as the effective start date for the account lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the virtual currency account. Active accounts allow normal earn/spend operations. Suspended accounts are temporarily blocked (e.g., fraud investigation). Frozen accounts are locked by compliance or legal hold. Closed accounts are permanently deactivated. Pending review accounts are under fraud or abuse assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: balance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current virtual currency balance (or a portion thereof) expires if unused. Applicable for event coins, promotional currencies, and time-limited battle pass tokens. Null for non-expiring currencies.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Tracks whether the player has ever converted from Free-to-Play (F2P) to a paying user via IAP on this account. Supports F2P conversion funnel analytics and re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics; AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this virtual currency account record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for the Silver Layer lakehouse record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Short uppercase alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the virtual currency denomination within the game economy (e.g., 'GEM', 'GOLD', 'BTKN'). Used in ledger entries and API payloads.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Schema

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the virtual currency as shown to players in-game (e.g., 'Gems', 'Gold Coins', 'Battle Tokens'). Used for player-facing UI and reporting.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the virtual currency held in this account. Hard currency is typically purchased with real money (e.g., gems, coins bought via IAP). Soft currency is earned through gameplay (e.g., gold, XP coins). Premium tokens are tied to specific premium content. Event coins are limited-time event currencies. Battle pass tokens are entitlement-linked currencies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hard_currency|soft_currency|premium_token|event_coin|battle_pass_token|season_pass_token|loyalty_point — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The real-time current balance of virtual currency units held in this account. This is the authoritative SSOT for the player's wallet state and must be reconcilable against the virtual_currency_ledger. Stored with 4 decimal places to support fractional currency economies.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic region where this account's data must be stored and processed to comply with data sovereignty and residency regulations (e.g., GDPR requires EU data to remain in EU). Drives lakehouse partition and storage routing decisions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44 (Data Transfers); European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: earn_cap_daily
attributes.description: Maximum virtual currency units that can be credited to this account within a single calendar day from gameplay rewards. Prevents exploit-based economy inflation and bot farming abuse.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: first_purchase_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the player's first real-money In-App Purchase (IAP) that credited this virtual currency account. Null for F2P accounts that have never converted. Key metric for FTUE-to-purchase funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to True when this account has been flagged for confirmed or suspected fraudulent activity (e.g., chargeback abuse, currency duplication, bot farming). Triggers account suspension workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Prevention Policy; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned to this account by the fraud detection system, reflecting the likelihood of fraudulent activity such as chargebacks, bot farming, or currency duplication exploits. Higher scores trigger manual review or automated suspension.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Prevention Policy; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: gdpr_erasure_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether a GDPR Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) request has been submitted for the player associated with this account. When True, the account must be scheduled for anonymization or deletion per GDPR Article 17 timelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: is_purchasable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency type can be acquired via real-money IAP. True for hard currencies; typically false for soft currencies earned through gameplay.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; Apple App Store Review Guidelines

attributes.name: is_refundable
