attributes.description: Version or release number of the middleware product licensed. Nullable for non-middleware agreements or version-agnostic licenses.

attributes.name: middleware_usage_scope
attributes.description: Description of permitted usage scope for middleware, including platform restrictions, title limits, or development team size constraints. Nullable for non-middleware agreements.

attributes.name: middleware_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the middleware vendor for middleware-type agreements. Nullable for non-middleware agreements.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed payment amount that the licensee must pay regardless of actual usage or revenue, typically in advance or over the agreement term. Nullable if no minimum guarantee applies.

attributes.name: music_composer_name
attributes.description: Name of the composer or songwriter for music synchronization licenses. Nullable for non-music agreements.

attributes.name: music_media_usage_rights
attributes.description: Description of permitted media usage rights for music synchronization, including platforms (console, PC, mobile, streaming), territories, and duration. Nullable for non-music agreements.

attributes.name: music_pro_clearance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Music Performing Rights Organization (PRO) Clearance Status
attributes.description: Status of clearance from performing rights organizations (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, PRS, etc.) for music synchronization licenses. Nullable for non-music agreements.

attributes.name: music_publisher_name
attributes.description: Name of the music publisher holding rights for music synchronization licenses. Nullable for non-music agreements.

attributes.name: music_track_title
attributes.description: Title of the music track or composition for music synchronization licenses. Nullable for non-music agreements.

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all financial terms in this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which royalty or license fee payments are due from the licensee.

attributes.name: renewal_negotiation_status
attributes.description: Current status of renewal negotiations for agreements approaching expiry.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry_date by which renewal notice must be provided to trigger automatic renewal or initiate renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to revenue or sales for revenue-share or per-unit royalty calculations. Nullable if not applicable to the royalty structure.

attributes.name: royalty_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty or payment structure: fixed fee (flat payment), revenue share (percentage of revenue), per-unit (per copy sold), per-seat (per developer license), tiered (rate changes by volume), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: termination_clause_summary
attributes.description: Summary of termination conditions and notice requirements, including breach conditions, convenience termination rights, and wind-down obligations.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territories or regions where the license is valid, specified as comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional descriptors (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'worldwide').

products.name: licensee
products.description: Master entity representing external parties who hold licenses from Gaming or grant licenses to Gaming — studios, publishers, developers, platform operators, music publishers, middleware vendors, and brand owners involved in any licensing relationship. Captures legal entity name, entity type (indie studio, AAA publisher, platform operator, middleware vendor, music publisher, brand owner), jurisdiction of incorporation, primary contact, credit rating, compliance tier, onboarding status, and relationship direction (licensee, licensor, or both). This is the SSOT for all external licensing counterparties regardless of deal direction.

attributes.name: licensee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the licensee entity. Primary key for the licensee master data product.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Licensees operate under specific legal jurisdictions determining tax obligations, legal framework, and regulatory compliance requirements. Fundamental business relationship for contract management and

attributes.name: annual_revenue_range
attributes.description: The estimated annual revenue range of the licensee organization in USD. Used for partner segmentation and deal sizing. Ranges: under $1M, $1M-$10M, $10M-$50M, $50M-$100M, $100M-$500M, over $500M.

attributes.name: compliance_tier
attributes.description: The compliance risk tier assigned to the licensee based on their jurisdiction, business practices, and regulatory history. Tier 1 (high risk, enhanced due diligence), Tier 2 (medium risk, standard due diligence), Tier 3 (low risk, simplified due diligence), Tier 4 (trusted partner, minimal oversight).
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Risk Framework, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this licensee record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum credit exposure allowed for this licensee across all active licensing agreements, expressed in USD. Used for financial risk management.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating assigned to the licensee by a recognized credit rating agency (e.g., Moody's, S&P, Fitch). Used for financial risk assessment and payment term determination.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: The trade name or DBA name under which the licensee operates, if different from their legal entity name. Used for brand recognition and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for unique business entity identification. Used for credit checks and business verification.

attributes.name: employee_count_range
attributes.description: The estimated number of employees at the licensee organization. Used for partner segmentation and capacity assessment. Ranges: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, over 1000.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the licensee based on their primary business function in the gaming ecosystem. Indie studio (small independent developer), AAA publisher (major game publisher), platform operator (console/store operator), middleware vendor (engine/tool provider), music publisher (audio IP owner), or brand owner (franchise IP holder).

attributes.name: first_contract_date
attributes.description: The date when the first licensing agreement with this licensee was executed. Used for relationship tenure analysis and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the licensee's headquarters street address, including building number and street name.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the licensee's headquarters address, typically used for suite, floor, or building information.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: The city where the licensee's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the licensee's headquarters location (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN).

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the licensee's headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region where the licensee's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: is_publicly_traded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the licensee is a publicly traded company (True) or privately held (False). Used for financial risk assessment and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the Know Your Customer due diligence process was completed and the licensee was approved for business. Required for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: kyc_review_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Due Date
attributes.description: The date when the next periodic KYC review is due for this licensee. Typically annual or biennial depending on compliance tier.

attributes.name: last_contract_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent contract renewal or amendment was executed with this licensee. Used for renewal cycle tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this licensee record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the licensee organization as registered in their jurisdiction of incorporation. This is the official name used in all licensing contracts and legal documents.

attributes.name: licensee_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the licensee for use in contracts, invoicing, and operational systems. Typically 4-12 characters.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional notes, special considerations, or context about the licensee that doesn't fit in structured fields. Used for relationship management and institutional knowledge.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score for this licensee based on relationship satisfaction surveys. Score ranges from -100 to +100, with higher scores indicating stronger partnership satisfaction.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: The current status of the licensee in the onboarding and lifecycle management process. Prospect (initial contact), KYC in progress (Know Your Customer due diligence underway), approved (cleared for contracting), active (has active agreements), suspended (temporarily inactive), terminated (relationship ended).

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the licensee's preferred transaction currency (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Used for invoicing and payment processing.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_terms_days
attributes.description: The standard payment terms in days negotiated with this licensee for royalty payments or license fees (e.g., Net 30, Net 60). Used for accounts payable and receivable management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for the licensee contact. This is the main channel for licensing communications, contract negotiations, and operational correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the primary business contact at the licensee organization responsible for licensing relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary phone number for the licensee contact, including country code. Used for urgent communications and contract discussions.

attributes.name: primary_platform_focus
attributes.description: The primary gaming platform(s) that the licensee focuses on (e.g., PC, Console, Mobile, VR, Cross-Platform). Free-text field to accommodate multiple platforms and emerging technologies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pc|console|mobile|vr|ar|xr|web|cross_platform — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: relationship_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the licensing relationship. Licensee (they license FROM Gaming), licensor (they license TO Gaming), or bilateral (both directions active).

attributes.name: relationship_manager_name
attributes.description: The name of the Gaming employee who serves as the primary relationship manager for this licensee. Responsible for contract negotiations, renewals, and ongoing relationship management.

attributes.name: specialization_area
attributes.description: The primary area of specialization or expertise for the licensee (e.g., Game Engine Technology, Audio Middleware, Physics Engine, Animation Tools, Multiplayer Infrastructure, Analytics SDK, Monetization Platform, IP Licensing, Music Licensing). Free-text to accommodate diverse specializations.

attributes.name: stock_ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The stock ticker symbol for the licensee if they are publicly traded. Includes exchange prefix if applicable (e.g., NASDAQ:ATVI, NYSE:EA).

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The tax identification number or equivalent (EIN, VAT number, etc.) for the licensee in their jurisdiction of incorporation. Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL for the licensee organization. Used for research, verification, and business intelligence.

products.name: licensed_ip
products.description: Catalog of all intellectual property assets that are subject to licensing — game engine SDKs (Unity/Unreal-equivalent), franchise brands, game titles, characters, music compositions, art asset libraries, middleware libraries, and rating-board-approved content packages. Captures IP asset name, IP type (engine, brand, music, art, middleware, franchise), ownership entity, registration numbers, territory restrictions, content rating classifications (ESRB, PEGI, USK, CERO, GRAC), and current licensing availability status.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the licensed intellectual property asset. Primary key for the licensed IP catalog.

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.franchise. Business justification: Franchises often license third-party IP (Marvel, Star Wars, sports leagues). Tracks which franchises depend on external IP rights for portfolio planning and renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: active_license_count
attributes.description: Current number of active licensing agreements in force for this IP asset. Used for portfolio management and capacity planning.

attributes.name: asset_thumbnail_url
attributes.description: URL path to the thumbnail image or visual representation of the IP asset stored in the Content Delivery Network (CDN) or digital asset management system.

attributes.name: cero_rating
attributes.description: CERO content rating classification for Japan (A=All Ages, B=12+, C=15+, D=17+, Z=18+, or Not Rated).
attributes.references: CERO (Computer Entertainment Rating Organization) Rating Standards

attributes.name: content_descriptors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of content warning descriptors from rating boards (e.g., 'Violence', 'Language', 'In-Game Purchases', 'Online Interactions'). Used for compliance and parental guidance.
attributes.references: ESRB, PEGI, USK, CERO, GRAC Content Descriptor Standards

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset and its associated content meet COPPA compliance requirements for children's privacy protection (applicable for content targeting users under 13).
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) - FTC Enforcement

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this IP asset record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP asset record was first created in the licensing catalog system.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: URL path to the official licensing documentation, SDK documentation, or technical specifications for this IP asset.

attributes.name: drm_protection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset includes or requires DRM (Digital Rights Management) protection mechanisms for distribution and licensing enforcement.

attributes.name: esrb_rating
attributes.description: ESRB content rating classification for North America (Early Childhood, Everyone, Everyone 10+, Teen, Mature, Adults Only, Rating Pending, or Not Rated).
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Rating Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the IP registration or protection expires. Null for perpetual rights or unregistered IP.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset and its licensing terms comply with GDPR data protection requirements for EU markets.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) - EU Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: grac_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Game Rating and Administration Committee (GRAC) Rating
attributes.description: GRAC content rating classification for South Korea (All, 12, 15, 18, or Not Rated).
attributes.references: GRAC (Game Rating and Administration Committee) Rating Standards

attributes.name: ip_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the IP asset (technology-based, creative content, brand/franchise, or hybrid).

attributes.name: ip_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code for the IP asset used in licensing agreements and royalty tracking.

attributes.name: ip_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the intellectual property asset, including its purpose, key features, and licensing value proposition.

attributes.name: ip_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the intellectual property asset (e.g., 'Unreal Engine 5', 'Fortnite Brand', 'Epic Soundtrack Collection').
attributes.references: WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization) Naming Standards

attributes.name: ip_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IP asset type. Determines licensing model and royalty structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: game_engine|franchise_brand|game_title|character|music_composition|art_asset_library|middleware_library|rating_approved_content_package — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_licensed_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent licensing agreement for this IP asset was executed. Null if never licensed.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this IP asset record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP asset record was last updated in the licensing catalog system.

attributes.name: license_model
attributes.description: Primary licensing business model applied to this IP asset (royalty percentage, fixed fee, subscription, revenue share, hybrid, or not applicable for internal-only IP).

attributes.name: licensing_availability_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of the IP asset for new licensing agreements. Indicates whether the IP can be licensed out and under what terms.

attributes.name: marketing_tagline
attributes.description: Official marketing tagline or slogan associated with the IP asset, used in licensing promotional materials and partner communications.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Standard minimum guarantee amount (in USD) required from licensees for this IP asset. Null if no minimum guarantee applies.

attributes.name: monetization_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions on how licensees can monetize products built with this IP (e.g., 'No Pay-to-Win mechanics allowed', 'In-App Purchases (IAP) permitted', 'Ad-supported only'). Null if no restrictions.
attributes.references: Internal Licensing Policy, FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: ownership_entity
attributes.description: The legal entity or studio that owns the intellectual property rights (e.g., 'Epic Games Inc.', 'Subsidiary Studio LLC').

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Nature of ownership rights held by the business (wholly owned, joint ownership with partner, licensed from third party, or acquired through M&A).

attributes.name: pegi_rating
attributes.description: PEGI content rating classification for Europe (3, 7, 12, 16, 18, or Not Rated).
attributes.references: PEGI (Pan European Game Information) Rating Standards

attributes.name: platform_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of gaming platforms or operating systems this IP asset supports or is compatible with (e.g., 'PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android'). Applicable primarily to game engines and middleware.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the intellectual property was officially registered with the governing authority.

attributes.name: registration_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or territory where the IP is registered (e.g., 'USA', 'EUR', 'JPN', 'Global'). Uses 3-letter country codes or regional identifiers.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or patent number assigned by governing IP authority (USPTO, EPO, WIPO, copyright office). May include trademark, patent, or copyright registration identifiers.
attributes.references: USPTO (United States Patent and Trademark Office), EPO (European Patent Office), WIPO

attributes.name: sdk_version
attributes.description: Current version number of the SDK or game engine technology if this IP is a licensable technology platform (e.g., 'UE5.3', 'Unity 2023.1'). Null for non-technology IP.

attributes.name: standard_royalty_rate
attributes.description: Default royalty rate (as decimal, e.g., 0.0500 for 5%) applied to licensees for this IP asset. Actual rates may vary by agreement. Null if not royalty-based.

attributes.name: territory_restrictions
attributes.description: Geographic territories where licensing of this IP is restricted or prohibited due to legal, regulatory, or contractual constraints. Comma-separated list of 3-letter country codes or 'None' if unrestricted.

attributes.name: third_party_dependencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of third-party middleware, libraries, or licensed components embedded within this IP asset that licensees must also comply with (e.g., 'Havok Physics', 'Wwise Audio', 'SpeedTree').

attributes.name: total_revenue_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative licensing revenue (in USD) generated from this IP asset since inception. Includes royalties, fixed fees, and minimum guarantees.

attributes.name: ugc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset supports or allows user-generated content creation and distribution by licensees or end users.

attributes.name: usk_rating
attributes.description: USK content rating classification for Germany (0, 6, 12, 16, 18, or Not Rated).

products.name: commercial_term
products.description: Detailed commercial and legal terms attached to each IP agreement, including royalty rate structures, minimum guarantee amounts, advance payment schedules, audit rights clauses, sublicensing permissions, derivative works rights, platform exclusivity windows, territory expansion options, renewal options, and termination-for-cause conditions. One agreement may have multiple versioned term sets reflecting amendments over time.

attributes.name: commercial_term_id
attributes.description: Primary key for commercial_term

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IP licensing agreement to which these commercial terms apply.

attributes.name: advance_payment_amount
attributes.description: Upfront payment made by licensee, typically recoupable against future royalties.

attributes.name: advance_recoupment_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms describing how advance payments are recouped from future royalty payments (e.g., 100% recoupment, cross-collateralization rules).

attributes.name: audit_frequency_limit
attributes.description: Maximum frequency at which licensor may conduct audits (e.g., once per calendar year, twice per contract term).

attributes.name: audit_rights_clause
attributes.description: Text describing licensors rights to audit licensees books and records to verify royalty calculations and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commercial term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this term set (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: derivative_works_rights
attributes.description: Specifies licensees rights to create derivative works based on the licensed IP (e.g., sequels, spin-offs, adaptations).

attributes.name: exclusivity_window_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for which platform or territory exclusivity applies before rights expand.

attributes.name: indemnification_terms
attributes.description: Detailed indemnification obligations of each party, including scope of liability, defense obligations, and limitations.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage penalty rate applied to overdue payments, typically expressed as annual percentage rate (APR).

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount either party may be held responsible for under the agreement, excluding certain carve-outs.

attributes.name: marketing_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee must obtain licensor approval for marketing materials, promotional campaigns, and brand usage.

attributes.name: marketing_spend_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum marketing spend amount licensee commits to invest in promoting the licensed IP or product.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed payment amount that licensee must pay regardless of actual royalty calculations. Common in IP licensing deals.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commercial term record was last modified.

attributes.name: payment_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after period end or invoice date by which payment must be received.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which royalty or license fee payments are due (e.g., quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: performance_milestone_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms describing performance milestones that trigger payments, bonuses, or rights adjustments (e.g., sales thresholds, user acquisition targets).

attributes.name: platform_exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement grants exclusive rights to specific gaming platforms (console, PC, mobile).

attributes.name: platform_exclusivity_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms covered by exclusivity (e.g., PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PC, iOS, Android).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_requirements
attributes.description: Quality standards and certification requirements licensee must meet, including ESRB, PEGI, or platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC) compliance.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration by which licensee must provide notice to exercise renewal option.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee has the option to renew the agreement under predefined terms.

attributes.name: renewal_option_periods
attributes.description: Number of renewal periods available to licensee (e.g., two 2-year renewal options).

attributes.name: revenue_reporting_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after period end by which revenue reports must be submitted to licensor.

attributes.name: revenue_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which licensee must provide revenue and usage reports to licensor for royalty calculation.

attributes.name: royalty_basis
attributes.description: The financial or usage metric upon which royalty calculations are based (e.g., net revenue, gross revenue, units sold).

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to revenue or units to calculate royalty payments owed to licensor. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: sublicensing_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee is permitted to sublicense the IP or technology to third parties.

attributes.name: sublicensing_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms governing sublicensing arrangements, including revenue sharing, approval requirements, and restrictions.

attributes.name: term_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of commercial terms becomes binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: term_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of commercial terms ceases to be effective. Nullable for open-ended terms.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this commercial term version.

attributes.name: term_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this term set. Agreements may have multiple versioned term sets reflecting amendments over time.

attributes.name: termination_cure_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the breaching party has to cure a breach before termination becomes effective.

attributes.name: termination_for_cause_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed conditions under which either party may terminate the agreement for cause (e.g., material breach, bankruptcy, failure to meet minimum guarantees).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination, either for cause or for convenience.

attributes.name: territory_expansion_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee has the option to expand into additional territories under predefined terms.

attributes.name: territory_expansion_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms governing territory expansion options, including pricing, approval process, and timing.

attributes.name: territory_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of countries or regions where license rights apply, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.

products.name: royalty_report
products.description: Periodic royalty reporting records submitted by licensees or generated internally for outbound agreements. Captures reporting period, reported gross and net revenue, reported unit sales, applicable royalty rate tier applied, calculated royalty amount due, currency, submission date, submission method, and report status (submitted, under review, accepted, disputed). Feeds into royalty invoice generation and audit workflows.

attributes.name: royalty_report_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the royalty report record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commercial_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.commercial_term. Business justification: A royalty report is calculated against a specific version of the commercial terms attached to an IP agreement. commercial_term has a term_version_number attribute, meaning an agreement can have multip

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Royalty calculations for licensed IP are often segmented by content release (base game vs DLC vs expansions). Reports need release attribution for accurate revenue allocation, licensor reporting, and

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: Royalty reports for licensed IP usage (middleware, music, brands) are calculated per-project for revenue attribution and payment reconciliation. Essential for financial reporting and budget variance a

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.game_title. Business justification: Royalty reports track revenue per title for licensed IP (engine royalties, music sync fees). Essential for accurate royalty calculation and licensor reporting.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensing agreement under which this royalty report is submitted. Links to the master license agreement entity.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Royalty reports must be filed per jurisdiction for tax and regulatory compliance, with different reporting standards by territory. Direct jurisdiction link needed for jurisdiction-specific reporting w

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Royalty metrics (royalty per user, IP conversion rate, royalty yield) are tracked as business KPIs. Links licensing financial reporting to analytics KPI framework for executive dashboards and performa

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Royalty reports should track which specific licensed IP asset generated the revenue. Currently uses product_line (STRING) which is ambiguous. Adding licensed_ip_id FK enables precise IP-level revenue

attributes.name: licensee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (studio, publisher, or third-party developer) submitting or subject to this royalty report.

attributes.name: title_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_sku. Business justification: Royalty calculations differ by SKU (physical vs digital, regional pricing tiers, bundle vs standalone). Accurate royalty reporting requires SKU-level revenue breakdown. Licensors audit royalty reports

attributes.name: applicable_royalty_rate
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage applied to the net revenue for this reporting period. May vary based on tiered thresholds, product type, or territory as defined in the license agreement.

attributes.name: attachment_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting documentation attached to this royalty report (e.g., detailed sales breakdowns, platform reports, reconciliation files).

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty report has been flagged for audit or detailed review due to discrepancies, thresholds, or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: calculated_royalty_amount
attributes.description: The royalty amount due to the licensor, calculated by applying the applicable royalty rate to the reported net revenue. This is the amount subject to invoicing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty report record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this report (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or categorization of any dispute raised regarding this royalty report. Populated when report status is disputed or under review.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency revenue to the reporting currency, if applicable. Used for multi-currency licensing agreements.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_credit
attributes.description: Amount of minimum guarantee advance recouped or credited against this royalty payment. Tracks progress toward recoupment of upfront payments.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty report record was last modified. Tracks updates, amendments, or status changes.

attributes.description: Target economy health score (0-100 scale) that represents optimal economy balance. Used for monitoring and automated adjustment decisions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this economy configuration expires and is no longer active. Null for open-ended configurations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this economy configuration becomes active and begins governing in-game economy behavior.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_primary_to_secondary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate Primary to Secondary Currency
attributes.description: Conversion rate from primary currency to secondary currency (e.g., 100 gold = 1 gem would be 0.01). Used for in-game currency conversion mechanics.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_secondary_to_primary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate Secondary to Primary Currency
attributes.description: Conversion rate from secondary currency to primary currency. May differ from inverse of primary-to-secondary rate to create conversion friction.

attributes.name: inflation_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated inflation control mechanisms are active for this economy configuration. When true, system may dynamically adjust earn/sink rates.

attributes.name: inflation_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable inflation rate (as percentage) before automated controls trigger. Measured as rate of currency supply growth exceeding sink rate.

attributes.name: max_balance_cap_primary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of primary currency a single player account can hold. Prevents hoarding and maintains economy balance.

attributes.name: max_balance_cap_secondary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of secondary currency a single player account can hold. Typically higher than primary currency cap for premium currency.

attributes.name: primary_currency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary virtual currency governed by this configuration (e.g., 'GOLD', 'GEMS', 'VBUCKS').

attributes.name: real_money_to_primary_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Money to Primary Currency Rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate from real-world currency (USD) to primary virtual currency for IAP (In-App Purchase) transactions. Used for monetization calculations.

attributes.name: real_money_to_secondary_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Money to Secondary Currency Rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate from real-world currency (USD) to secondary virtual currency for IAP transactions. Typically more favorable than primary currency rate.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country or region code where this economy configuration applies (e.g., USA, EUR, JPN). Null for global configurations.

attributes.name: sink_rate_target_secondary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this economy configuration record was last modified.

products.name: campaign_item
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific MTX catalog item in a monetization offer campaign. It captures campaign-specific pricing, discounts, display ordering, eligibility rules, and redemption limits that exist only in the context of this campaign-item pairing. Each record links one offer_campaign to one mtx_catalog item with attributes that govern how that item is presented and priced within the campaign.. Existence Justification: In gaming monetization operations, offer campaigns routinely bundle multiple MTX catalog items with campaign-specific pricing, discounts, and display rules. A single campaign (e.g., Black Friday Flash Sale) includes many catalog items (currency packs, cosmetics, DLC), and a single catalog item (e.g., a popular skin) appears in many campaigns over time (seasonal events, whale retention offers, returning player promotions). The business actively manages these campaign-item pairings with specific pricing overrides, redemption limits, and merchandising rules that belong to neither the campaign nor the catalog item alone.

attributes.name: campaign_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each campaign-item pairing. Primary key.

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MTX catalog item included in this campaign.

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the offer campaign that includes this catalog item.

attributes.name: campaign_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to this specific catalog item within this campaign, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off). Overrides base catalog pricing for campaign duration.

attributes.name: campaign_specific_price
attributes.description: Absolute override price for this catalog item within this campaign, denominated in the campaign's currency_code. If set, this price supersedes both base_price_usd and campaign_discount_pct calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign_item record was first created in the system. Standard audit field.

attributes.name: display_order_in_campaign
attributes.description: Integer sort order controlling the presentation sequence of this item within the campaign's storefront UI. Lower values appear first. Used for merchandising and promotional emphasis.

attributes.name: eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicating whether this catalog item is currently eligible for purchase within this campaign. Allows dynamic inclusion/exclusion without removing the campaign_item record (e.g., inventory depletion, compliance hold).

attributes.name: featured_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicating whether this item receives featured/hero placement within the campaign UI (e.g., banner image, top carousel slot). Used for merchandising strategy.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Number of times this specific catalog item was displayed to players within this campaign context. Used for item-level conversion rate analysis and A/B testing.

attributes.name: item_added_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog item was added to the campaign. Supports audit trail and dynamic campaign composition tracking.

attributes.name: item_removed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog item was removed from the campaign (if applicable). Null if item is still active in campaign. Supports historical analysis of campaign composition changes.

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times this specific catalog item was purchased/redeemed within this campaign. Used for item-level performance tracking and inventory management.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_item
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single player account can redeem this specific catalog item within this campaign. Null indicates no per-item limit (campaign-level cap still applies). Used for flash sale scarcity and whale retention offers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign_item record was last modified. Standard audit field.

Distinct from monetization: monetization owns virtual economy design; billing owns the real-money settlement layer.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item, including promotional discounts, coupon redemptions, loyalty rewards, or platform sale pricing. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Promotional code, coupon identifier, or campaign code applied to this line item. Null if no discount code was used.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice, used for ordering and referencing individual line items on the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of this invoice line item: active (valid charge), refunded (fully refunded), partially_refunded (partial refund issued), disputed (under dispute), or chargeback (payment reversed by card issuer).

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: Final total for this line item including all discounts and taxes: subtotal + tax_amount. This is the amount recognized for this line. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Original catalog or storefront list price per unit before promotional discounts. Used to calculate discount percentage and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Updated when refunds, chargebacks, or status changes occur. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Net revenue after platform fees: line_total - platform_fee_amount. This is the amount the studio receives after platform revenue share. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the distribution platform or storefront (e.g., 30% Apple/Google fee, Steam revenue share). Deducted from gross revenue to calculate net payout. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: platform_fee_rate
attributes.description: Platform fee rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 for 30% platform fee). Used for financial modeling and payout reconciliation.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) purchased on this line. Typically 1 for digital goods; may be greater than 1 for virtual currency bundles or multi-license purchases.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded for this line item. Zero if no refund has been issued. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed for this line item. Null if no refund has been issued.

attributes.name: refund_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is eligible for refund based on platform policies (e.g., Steam 2-hour/14-day policy, Apple/Google refund windows). True if refundable, False if non-refundable.

attributes.name: refund_window_end_date
attributes.description: Last date on which a refund can be requested for this line item per platform policy. Null if item is non-refundable or refund window has no expiration.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Accounting treatment for revenue recognition: immediate (one-time purchase), deferred (season pass, pre-order), subscription (recurring), or usage-based (consumable virtual currency).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_end_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition ends for this line item. Null for immediate recognition. For subscriptions or deferred items, marks the end of the recognition period.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_start_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition begins for this line item. For immediate recognition, equals the invoice date. For deferred or subscription items, marks the start of the recognition period.

attributes.name: subscription_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the subscription billing period for subscription line items. Null for non-subscription purchases.

attributes.name: subscription_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the subscription billing period for subscription line items. Null for non-subscription purchases.

attributes.name: subtotal
attributes.description: Line total after discounts but before taxes: (quantity × unit_price) - discount_amount. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax applied to this line item, including sales tax, Value-Added Tax (VAT), Goods and Services Tax (GST), or other jurisdiction-specific taxes. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic tax jurisdiction code or name where the tax was assessed (e.g., state, province, country). Required for multi-jurisdiction tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate applied to this line item, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0750 for 7.5%). Used for tax reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per single unit of the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) before any discounts or taxes. Expressed in the invoice currency.

products.name: payment

Captures payment amount, currency, payment timestamp, payment method type (credit card, PayPal, platform wallet, gift card), payment gateway reference, authorization code, settlement status, and storefront channel. SSOT for all real-money payment receipts across all distribution platforms. PCI DSS-compliant — no raw card data stored.

While payment captures point-in-time card details (card_last_four_digits, card_brand, expiry dates) as historical

attributes.name: spend_limit_control_id

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront. Business justification: Payment settlement and platform fee calculation require storefront context. Gaming platform operators calculate revenue share per storefront per payment for financial reporting and settlement. No exis

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: method_type

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount received by the business after deducting platform fees, payment gateway fees, and taxes from the gross payment amount. This is the recognized revenue for financial reporting.

attributes.name: payer_email

attributes.name: payment_description

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|authorized|captured|settled|failed|declined|refunded|partially_refunded|chargeback — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: payment_instrument
products.description: PCI DSS-compliant master record of a player's stored payment method. Captures tokenized card reference (no raw PAN), payment method type (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PSN Wallet, Xbox Wallet), billing address reference, expiry month/year, issuing bank BIN, instrument status (active, expired, suspended), and vault provider (Braintree, Stripe, Adyen). SSOT for all stored payment credentials.

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment instrument record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_policy. Business justification: Payment instruments require consent policies for storing payment data under GDPR/PCI-DSS (explicit consent for tokenization, recurring billing consent). Critical privacy-billing intersection.

attributes.name: data_subject_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.data_subject_request. Business justification: Payment instruments deleted via GDPR/CCPA data subject requests (right to erasure) must reference DSRs for compliance audit trails and data deletion verification.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Payment instruments must track issuing jurisdiction for PCI-DSS compliance scope, payment method restrictions (regional regulations), and fraud rule enforcement. Core payment compliance requirement.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Payment instruments must reference payment data handling policies for PCI-DSS compliance, data retention policies, and tokenization policies for audit compliance.

attributes.name: processing_activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.processing_activity. Business justification: Payment instruments involve data processing activities (payment data storage, tokenization, recurring billing) that must be tracked in GDPR Article 30 records.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Payment instruments must reference regulatory obligations governing payment data storage (PCI-DSS, GDPR data minimization, regional payment regulations) for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: spend_limit_control_id

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for Address Verification Service (AVS) checks.

attributes.description: The state or province of the billing address. Used for tax calculation and AVS.

attributes.description: The date when this payment instrument record is scheduled for deletion per data retention policies and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: deleted_timestamp

attributes.name: expiry_month

attributes.name: expiry_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an expiration notification has been sent to the player for this payment instrument.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: The expiration year of the payment instrument (four-digit year). Used to validate instrument validity.

attributes.name: failed_transaction_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of failed transaction attempts using this payment instrument. Used for fraud detection and instrument health monitoring.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment instrument has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: A calculated risk score (0-100) indicating the likelihood of fraudulent activity associated with this payment instrument. Higher scores indicate higher risk.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp

attributes.name: is_default

attributes.name: is_verified

attributes.name: issuing_bank_bin

attributes.description: The name of the financial institution that issued the payment instrument. Derived from BIN lookup.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.description: The last four digits of the card number for display and player identification purposes. Safe to store per PCI DSS.

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: The type of payment instrument (e.g., credit card, PayPal, digital wallet). Represents the payment instrument category. attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment instrument is enrolled in 3D Secure authentication (Verified by Visa, Mastercard SecureCode, etc.).

attributes.description: The third-party payment vault provider that securely stores the tokenized payment instrument (e.g., Braintree, Stripe, Adyen).

attributes.description: The method used to verify the payment instrument (Address Verification Service, CVV check, 3D Secure, etc.).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp

attributes.name: is_subscription

attributes.name: order_status

attributes.name: order_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_authorized_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage

attributes.name: refund_amount

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Master billing account record linking a player identity to their real-money financial relationship with the platform. Captures account status (active, suspended, closed, under-review), account creation date, default payment instrument reference, billing address, preferred currency, tax exemption status, lifetime spend amount, account balance (store credit), fraud risk score, and dunning status. SSOT for the player's billing identity — distinct from the player profile (owned by the player domain) and from virtual wallet (owned by monetization domain).

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key for the billing account entity.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Billing accounts must track tax jurisdiction for proper tax calculation, VAT/GST compliance, and regulatory reporting. Core billing compliance requirement in multi-jurisdiction gaming operations.

attributes.name: licensee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensee. Business justification: Licensees (publishers, developers, middleware vendors) maintain billing accounts for royalty payments, license fees, and revenue shares. Enables licensee financial management, payment term enforcement

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player identity who owns this billing account. Links the billing account to the player domain master record.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Billing accounts must reference master compliance policies governing their operations (data retention policies, privacy policies, payment handling policies) for governance and audit compliance.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique account number for customer service and billing correspondence. Format: BA followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts can transact; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; closed accounts are permanently terminated; under-review accounts are flagged for fraud investigation; pending-activation accounts await verification; delinquent accounts have overdue payments.

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Segmentation tier based on lifetime spend and engagement. Standard represents typical players; premium represents moderate spenders; VIP represents high-value players; whale represents top-tier spenders with dedicated account management.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing account was activated and became eligible for transactions. May differ from creation timestamp if verification was required.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether automatic renewal is enabled for recurring subscriptions on this account. False requires manual renewal by player.

attributes.name: balance
attributes.description: Current store credit or wallet balance available for purchases. Positive balance represents prepaid funds; negative balance represents outstanding debt. Denominated in preferred currency.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for billing correspondence and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for billing address. Critical for tax jurisdiction and fraud detection.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code for billing address. Used for sales tax calculation.

attributes.name: chargeback_count
attributes.description: Total number of chargebacks filed against this account. High chargeback rates may result in account suspension and increased fraud scrutiny.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.8, Chargeback Management Standard

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this account is subject to COPPA restrictions (player under 13 years old in the US). True enforces parental consent requirements and restricted data collection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing account was first created in the system. Represents the start of the billing relationship.

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when billing account data must be purged or anonymized per GDPR right-to-erasure or internal data retention policies. Null for active accounts with ongoing retention requirements.

attributes.name: dunning_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of dunning cycles (payment retry attempts) executed for the current outstanding balance. Resets to zero when balance is cleared.

attributes.name: dunning_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the payment recovery process for failed recurring charges. None indicates no outstanding issues; soft-dunning represents initial retry attempts; hard-dunning indicates escalated recovery; final-notice is last warning before suspension; collections indicates account sent to external recovery.

attributes.name: failed_transaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of failed payment transactions on this account. High failure rates trigger fraud alerts and dunning workflows.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the account has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. True triggers additional verification steps for transactions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.8, Fraud Prevention Standard

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated fraud risk score ranging from 0.00 (lowest risk) to 100.00 (highest risk). Generated by fraud detection algorithms based on transaction patterns, device fingerprints, and behavioral analysis.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.8, Fraud Prevention Standard

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Consent Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the player provided explicit consent for processing billing and payment data under GDPR Article 6. Required for EU players.

attributes.name: last_failed_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent failed payment transaction. Used to trigger dunning workflows and fraud alerts.

attributes.name: last_successful_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful payment transaction on this account. Used for account activity monitoring and churn prediction.

attributes.name: lifetime_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount spent by this billing account across all transactions since account creation. Denominated in the accounts preferred currency. Used for player segmentation and LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the player has consented to receive promotional offers and marketing communications related to billing and monetization. Required for GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance.

attributes.name: parental_consent_verified
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether parental consent has been verified for accounts subject to COPPA or similar child protection regulations. Required before processing payments for minors.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_scope
attributes.business_glossary_term: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Compliance Scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account stores payment card data subject to PCI DSS requirements. In-scope accounts require full compliance controls; out-of-scope accounts do not handle card data; tokenized-only accounts use vault tokens exclusively.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the players preferred currency for pricing display and billing. Transactions may still settle in platform currency.

attributes.name: refund_count
attributes.description: Total number of refunds issued to this account. Used for customer satisfaction analysis and fraud pattern detection.

attributes.name: subscription_active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the account has at least one active recurring subscription (e.g., battle pass, premium membership). Used for churn analysis and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: successful_transaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of successful payment transactions on this account. Used to calculate transaction success rate.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Government-issued certificate number supporting tax exemption claim. Required for audit trail when tax_exemption_status is exempt or partial.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax exemption certificate expires and must be renewed. Null for permanent exemptions or non-exempt accounts.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account qualifies for sales tax exemption. Exempt accounts bypass tax calculation; partial exemptions apply reduced rates; pending-verification accounts await documentation review.

attributes.name: total_transaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of all payment transactions (successful and failed) processed on this account since creation. Used for engagement and fraud analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this billing account record. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: skill_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum skill rating threshold for acceptable match opponents. Matchmaking will expand this range over time if no suitable match is found. Used to balance match quality vs. wait time.

attributes.description: The exact date and time when the player submitted the matchmaking request. Used to calculate wait time and queue performance metrics. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the matchmaking ticket. Queued: waiting for match; Matched: successfully assigned to server session; Expired: exceeded max wait time; Cancelled: player or system cancelled; Failed: matchmaking error; Timeout: system timeout.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this matchmaking ticket record was last modified (e.g., status change, match assignment). Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: wait_duration_seconds

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages regulatory compliance obligations, audit schedules, loot box probability disclosure requirements, GDPR/COPPA data subject requests, age rating certification tracking, and jurisdictional regulatory reporting across all territories where games are published.

products.name: regulatory_obligation
products.description: Master catalog of all regulatory compliance obligations applicable to Gaming across jurisdictions — covering GDPR, COPPA, loot box disclosure laws, age rating mandates, digital goods VAT, esports betting regulations, and platform-specific compliance requirements. Each record defines the obligation type, governing body, applicable territories, enforcement mechanism, and current compliance status. Serves as the authoritative registry that all other compliance activities reference.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory compliance obligation record.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id

attributes.name: applicable_platforms

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Required or planned frequency of compliance audits for this obligation.

attributes.name: compliance_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for ensuring compliance with this obligation.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of Gaming with respect to this obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days that data must be retained to satisfy this obligation. NULL if not applicable or variable.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official regulatory documentation, guidance, or internal compliance procedures for this obligation.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: enforcement_mechanism

attributes.name: estimated_implementation_cost

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: governing_body

attributes.name: implementation_deadline

attributes.name: last_audit_date

attributes.name: maximum_penalty_amount

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit of this obligation.

attributes.name: next_reporting_deadline
attributes.description: Next scheduled deadline for submitting compliance reports to the governing body.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, context, or special considerations related to this regulatory obligation.

attributes.name: obligation_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the regulatory obligation (e.g., GDPR-ART17, COPPA-CONSENT, LOOTBOX-DISC-EU).

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the regulatory obligation requires Gaming to do or refrain from doing.

attributes.name: obligation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the regulatory obligation (e.g., Right to Erasure, Parental Consent Requirement, Loot Box Probability Disclosure).

attributes.name: obligation_type

attributes.name: penalty_description

attributes.name: reporting_frequency

attributes.name: requires_age_verification

attributes.name: requires_data_portability

attributes.name: requires_data_retention
